assets.description: Ranked per-asset rows; item fields: asof_day, asset, universe_tag, comp_score, comp_rank_eq, comp_rank_pct, price_anchor (omitted in series mode), ret_1d, ret_7d, ret_30d, vol_rv_7d, vol_rv_30d, sharpe_7d, sharpe_30d, regime, regime_confidence. In series mode assets[] carries daily rows across the last N days.

_next.description: Recommended paid x402 next-call hints (e.g. /api/market-pulse/conviction, /api/asset/thesis).

usage.callShape: GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/assets and settle the x402 402 challenge (Base USDC, $0.01). No required input — a bare GET returns the current snapshot. Optional query params: mode (snapshot|series), assets (comma-separated symbols filter), universes (comma-separated universe-tag filter), days (int 1-365, default 30). Result is returned inline in the 200 response.
usage.outputShape: JSON object { ok (bool), mode (snapshot|series), asof_day (date), count (int), assets: [ { asof_day, asset, universe_tag, comp_score, comp_rank_eq, comp_rank_pct, price_anchor, ret_1d, ret_7d, ret_30d, vol_rv_7d, vol_rv_30d, sharpe_7d, sharpe_30d, regime, regime_confidence } ], _next: {...} }. Paid snapshot run returned count=189 ranked assets for asof_day 2026-07-29.
usage.quirks: No input required — bare GET is a valid payable call (mode defaults to snapshot). Numeric fields come back as strings in the live response (e.g. comp_score "56.49", vol_rv_7d "154.67", sharpe_7d "0.18") — parse to number. Some assets have null price_anchor/returns/vol/sharpe when underlying price data is missing but still carry a comp_score, rank and regime. In series mode price_anchor is omitted and assets[] becomes daily rows across the last N days. Snapshot payload is ~73KB / ~189 rows. The _next block points at sibling paid endpoints (/api/market-pulse/conviction, /api/asset/thesis) for drill-down.
usage.guide: Call GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/assets and settle the $0.01 x402 payment (USDC on Base) for the full 200+ crypto-asset master ranking. Use mode=snapshot (default) for the latest per-asset row or mode=series with days=N (1-365) for daily history; filter with assets=BTC,ETH,SOL or universes=<tag>. Each row has comp_score + comp_rank_eq/comp_rank_pct (ranking), ret_1d/7d/30d (returns), vol_rv_7d/30d (realised vol), sharpe_7d/30d, and per-asset regime + regime_confidence — sort by comp_rank_eq for the master ranking. Note numeric fields arrive as strings; parse them, and expect nulls where price data is unavailable.

name: Cryptyx Intelligence Query
description: Natural-language entry point to the entire Cryptyx crypto-intelligence stack: POST a plain-English question, an LLM classifies it into 60+ intents (conviction ranking, market brief, factor breakdown, signal explain, regime check, top setups, thesis, etc.) and routes it to the matching pre-computed analytics over 200+ assets, 152 signals, and 440+ metrics, returning an intent-shaped JSON payload.

query.description: Natural-language intelligence question (1-1000 chars). Examples: 'highest conviction assets', 'signals firing on BTC', 'thesis for ETH', 'regime analog to today'. Required.

format.description: Response format. Only 'json' supported. Defaults to 'json'. Optional.

intent.description: Classified intent, e.g. conviction_ranking, market_brief, signal_active, factor_breakdown, regime_check, top_setups.

data.description: Intent-shaped payload; shape varies by intent.

source_endpoint.description: Internal analytics source the router resolved to.

_next.description: Recommended follow-up paid Cryptyx x402 endpoints with {path, method, price_usd, reason}.

usage.callShape: POST https://cryptyx.ai/api/intelligence/query with JSON body {"query": "<natural-language question>", "format": "json"}. Only 'query' is required (1-1000 chars); 'format' is optional and only 'json' is supported. Pay the x402 402 challenge ($0.25 USDC on Base, eip155:8453). Result is returned inline in the 200 response.
usage.outputShape: JSON object: ok (bool), intent (classified intent string, e.g. conviction_ranking), confidence (0..1), query (echo), data (intent-shaped payload — for a conviction_ranking it is {assets:[{asset,score,rank,ret_1d,ret_7d,asof_day}], as_of, count}; other intents like market_brief return a full universe snapshot instead), source_endpoint (internal analytics source), response_time_ms, and _next (object with description + hints[] of recommended follow-up paid Cryptyx endpoints, each {path, method, price_usd, reason}).
quirks: The response is INTENT-SHAPED: the data payload varies by the classified intent (a top-3 conviction query returns a compact ranking; a market_brief returns a full universe snapshot; a per-asset question returns asset-specific analytics). Callers must branch on the top-level 'intent' field.

Verified live 2026-07-29 with {"query":"top 3 assets by conviction"}: intent=conviction_ranking, confidence=0.98, returned KAITO/OKB/GT ranked by score with ret_1d/ret_7d; data is a point-in-time daily snapshot keyed by asof_day/as_of.
Single flat $0.25 charge regardless of which intent it routes to (more than the individual per-op endpoints, since it fronts the whole stack via an LLM classifier).

The payment-required data (accepts + input/output schema) is delivered both in the base64 'payment-required' HTTP 402 header and mirrored in the CDP bazaar extension; amount 250000 (6 decimals) = $0.25 USDC.

Response includes a _next block whose hints reference other paid Cryptyx endpoints (/api/signals/catalog, /api/market-pulse/conviction, /api/asset/thesis, /api/asset/asymmetry, /api/v1/ai/trade-ideas) to drill down after the NL answer.
usage.guide: Natural-language front door to the Cryptyx crypto-intelligence stack. POST https://cryptyx.ai/api/intelligence/query with body {"query":"<plain-English question>","format":"json"} (only 'query' required, 1-1000 chars) and settle the $0.25 USDC x402 payment on Base. An LLM classifies the question into one of 60+ intents (conviction ranking, market brief, factor breakdown, signal explain, regime check, top setups, thesis, etc.) and returns an intent-shaped JSON payload: top-level ok/intent/confidence/query, a data object whose shape depends on the intent, source_endpoint, response_time_ms, and a _next block of recommended paid follow-up endpoints. Use this when you want to ask Cryptyx a question in English without wiring up its 30+ individual endpoints; branch on the returned 'intent' to parse 'data'.

name: Cryptyx IV Surface
description: Latest-day Deribit implied-volatility term structure for one asset (BTC or ETH) — per-tenor ATM IV, 25-delta risk reversal and butterfly, 25-delta call/put IV, plus the current put/call open-interest ratio; feeds Cryptyx's OPT factor class for skew reads and vol-term structuring.

asset.description: Asset symbol — uppercased server-side. Deribit scope: BTC or ETH only. Required.

usage.callShape: GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/iv-surface?asset={asset}. Required query param: asset (BTC or ETH ONLY — Deribit scope; uppercased server-side). No request body. Pays $0.05 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453). Result is returned inline in the 200 (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: term_structure[] each { tenor (1w/1m/3m/...), atm_iv, rr_25d, bf_25d, iv_25c, iv_25p } (all numeric-as-string, in IV percent points e.g. "38.20"); pcr { pcr, oi_put, oi_call } (numeric-as-string); asof_day (YYYY-MM-DD); plus _next.hints[] advertising other paid Cryptyx endpoints. Verified live: asset=BTC -> term_structure [1w atm_iv 38.20 rr_25d -4.72, 1m atm_iv 35.76, 3m atm_iv 37.09], pcr 0.31 (oi_put 132611.6, oi_call 295160.3), asof_day 2026-07-29.
quirks: asset is REQUIRED and limited to BTC or ETH (Deribit options scope); other symbols will not return meaningful data. A bare GET with no asset returns HTTP 500, so always supply asset.
All numeric fields are returned as STRINGS (e.g. atm_iv "38.20", pcr "0.31000540241189288029") — parse to number client-side.
Live IV/RR/BF values are in percentage points (atm_iv ~38.20), whereas the bazaar output example uses decimal fractions (atm_iv 0.482) — treat the example as illustrative of shape, not units.
Latest-day only: asof_day reflects a nightly pipeline and lags wall-clock; there is no history/series mode on this endpoint.
Response includes a _next.hints[] block advertising other paid Cryptyx endpoints; ignore it unless chaining calls.
usage.guide: Cryptyx IV Surface returns the latest-day Deribit implied-volatility term structure for one asset. GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/iv-surface?asset={asset} where asset is BTC or ETH ONLY (Deribit scope; uppercased server-side). No request body. Pays $0.05 USDC via x402 on Base. Returns JSON inline (synchronous): term_structure[] with per-tenor (1w/1m/3m...) atm_iv, rr_25d (25-delta risk reversal), bf_25d (25-delta butterfly), iv_25c and iv_25p; pcr { pcr (put/call OI ratio), oi_put, oi_call }; and asof_day. All numbers come back as strings in percent points, so parse client-side. Use it for options skew reads, vol-term structuring, and as the OPT factor input alongside Cryptyx's regime/asymmetry endpoints.

name: Cryptyx Market History
description: Daily OHLCV bars (open, high, low, close, USD volume) for one crypto asset over a 1-1825 day lookback window, anchored to the latest UTC-1 pipeline day — the grounded spot tape behind every Cryptyx factor score and signal.

inputSchema.description: asset (required) = asset ticker, e.g. BTC/ETH/SOL (uppercased + trimmed server-side). days (optional int, 1-1825, default 90) = lookback window in days, anchored to the latest pipeline day.

asof_day.description: Latest anchor day (UTC-1) covered by the window.

candles.description: One record per daily bar: { asof_day (date), asset (string), open_px (number), high_px (number), low_px (number), close_px (number), volume_usd (number) }, oldest-first.

_next.description: Recommended follow-up paid Cryptyx endpoints (hints[] with path/method/price_usd/reason).

usage.callShape: GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/market-history?asset=BTC&days=90. REQUIRED query param: asset (ticker, e.g. BTC/ETH/SOL). Optional: days (int 1-1825, default 90) = lookback window. No request body. Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453).
usage.outputShape: ok (bool); asset (string, echoes input); days (int, echoes requested window); asof_day (date, latest UTC-1 anchor day); count (int, number of candles); candles = array (oldest-first) of daily bars, each { asof_day (date), asset (string), open_px (number), high_px (number), low_px (number), close_px (number), volume_usd (number) }; _next = { description, hints[] } of recommended follow-up paid Cryptyx endpoints. A days=90 request returned count=91 candles for BTC (asof_day 2026-07-29).
quirks: asset is REQUIRED — a bare GET with no asset returns a 402 challenge but the paid call would 400 without it; always supply asset.
days range is 1-1825 (~5 years), default 90; a days=90 request returned 91 candles (window is inclusive/anchor-adjusted, so count can be days+1).
candles are oldest-first, anchored to the latest UTC-1 pipeline day (asof_day is the last/newest bar).
Prices (open_px/high_px/low_px/close_px) and volume_usd are returned as raw JSON numbers, not strings.
Response includes a _next.hints[] block advertising other paid Cryptyx endpoints (asset/asymmetry, asset/active-signals, asset/thesis, market-pulse/conviction, v1/ai/trade-ideas) at $0.05-$0.10 each.
usage.guide: Cryptyx Market History returns the grounded daily OHLCV tape for one crypto asset in a single paid call. GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/market-history?asset=BTC&days=90 — asset is REQUIRED (ticker like BTC/ETH/SOL); days is optional (1-1825, default 90) and sets the lookback window. No request body; pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base. The response is { ok, asset, days, asof_day, count, candles[] } where each candle is { asof_day, asset, open_px, high_px, low_px, close_px, volume_usd } (oldest-first, anchored to the latest UTC-1 day). This is the same spot data behind Cryptyx's factor scores and signals — use it for price history, volatility/return calcs, or as the OHLCV base layer before pulling the analytic panels in _next.hints (asset/asymmetry, asset/thesis, market-pulse/conviction).

name: Cryptyx Composite Breakdown
description: Latest-day snapshot of where Cryptyx's 9 IC-weighted crypto composites (regime + thematic) are actually firing across 200+ assets: per-composite triggered/evaluated asset counts, breadth %, and average confidence.

asset.description: Optional asset filter (ticker, e.g. BTC) for a per-asset composite view. Omit for the whole-market snapshot.

composites.description: One row per composite: { composite_id, name, composite_type (REGIME|THEMATIC), n_assets_triggered, n_assets_evaluated, avg_confidence, breadth_pct }. Counts and breadth_pct are returned as strings.

_next.description: Recommended paid follow-up Cryptyx endpoints

usage.callShape: GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/market-pulse/composite-breakdown. Whole-market (universe-wide) by default; the only input is an OPTIONAL ?asset=<ticker> query param for a per-asset composite view. No request body, no required params — a bare GET is payable. Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453).
usage.outputShape: JSON: { ok (bool), asof_day (YYYY-MM-DD), composites[], durationMs, _next }. Each composites[] row: composite_id (e.g. REGIME_CONSOLIDATION, REGIME_DELEVERAGING, REGIME_EXPANSION, COMP_CONVICTION, COMP_CORRELATION, COMP_FLOW, COMP_MICROSTRUCTURE, COMP_MOMENTUM, COMP_RISK), name (human title), composite_type (REGIME | THEMATIC), n_assets_triggered, n_assets_evaluated, breadth_pct (all three returned as STRINGS), avg_confidence (float 0..1). Verified live 2026-07-29: 9 composites over ~200 evaluated assets, Consolidation leading at 25.2% breadth. _next.hints[] each carry {path, method, price_usd, reason} pointing at paid follow-up endpoints (market-pulse/conviction, market-pulse/factor-cross-section, asset/thesis, asset/asymmetry, v1/ai/trade-ideas).
quirks: GET with NO required params — a bare call returns the whole-market snapshot across all 9 composites; add ?asset=<ticker> for the optional per-asset composite view.
Numeric-looking fields n_assets_triggered, n_assets_evaluated and breadth_pct are returned as STRINGS (e.g. "51", "25.2"); avg_confidence is a real number. Callers must coerce.

The live response shape is richer than the bazaar example in the 402 header (which showed CMP_TREND_QUALITY with triggered_asset_count / top_triggering_assets); the actual bare-call rows use composite_id/name/composite_type/n_assets_triggered/n_assets_evaluated/avg_confidence/breadth_pct and did NOT include top_triggering_assets. Treat the header example as illustrative, the outputExample here as observed.
Response is a point-in-time daily snapshot keyed by asof_day, so contents change day to day.

Response includes a _next block referencing other paid Cryptyx endpoints (market-pulse/conviction, market-pulse/factor-cross-section, asset/thesis, asset/asymmetry, v1/ai/trade-ideas) to drill from 'which composite is firing' into named assets and theses.
Single accept: Base (eip155:8453) USDC only — no Solana lane. Payment details delivered both in the base64 'payment-required' HTTP header and the JSON body of the 402.
usage.guide: Call GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/market-pulse/composite-breakdown with no params for the whole-market snapshot, or add ?asset=<ticker> for a per-asset view. Pay the x402 402 with USDC on Base ($0.01). Read composites[] to see which of Cryptyx's 9 IC-weighted composites (3 REGIME + 6 THEMATIC) are firing right now: each row gives n_assets_triggered / n_assets_evaluated, breadth_pct (breadth of the signal across the universe), and avg_confidence. Use it as a market-wide 'where are signals concentrated' scan, then follow _next.hints into market-pulse/conviction (named assets) or asset/thesis for drill-down.

name: Cryptyx Market Pulse Conviction
description: Daily 'where to look' crypto leaderboard: top-N and bottom-N assets ranked by composite score, with 1d/7d returns, funding/OI z-scores, 7d Sharpe, signal counts, thematic component scores, and per-asset macro-regime gating (stablecoins filtered).

limit.description: Number of assets per side (top and bottom). Integer 5-50, default 10. Optional query param.

usage.callShape: GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/market-pulse/conviction. All input is OPTIONAL query params: 'limit' (integer 5-50, default 10) = number of assets returned per side (top and bottom). No request body, no required params. Pays $0.05 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453).
usage.outputShape: Top-level: ok (bool), asof_day (YYYY-MM-DD snapshot date), top[] and bottom[] arrays, _next (object of recommended follow-up calls), durationMs. Each top/bottom entry: asset (ticker), comp_score (composite score float), comp_rank (int, 1 = strongest overall), ret_1d, ret_7d (returns as fractions), funding_z, oi_roc_z (z-scores, may be null), n_atomic, n_composite (triggered signal counts), sharpe_7d, thematic_scores (map of COMP_* component -> 0..1, may be null), regime (e.g. expansion/consolidation/deleveraging), regime_confidence (0..1). _next.hints[] each carry {path, method, price_usd, reason} pointing at the per-asset Cryptyx endpoints (thesis, active-signals, asymmetry, regime-context, trade-ideas).
quirks: GET with no required params — a bare call returns the default top-10 / bottom-10; use ?limit=N (5-50) to widen or narrow each side.
Verified live 2026-07-29: top ranked KAITO/OKB/GT..., bottom ZIL/DEXE/WEMIX...; response is a point-in-time daily snapshot keyed by asof_day, so contents change day to day.
funding_z and oi_roc_z can be null for assets without derivatives data (e.g. RLUSD, AB); thematic_scores can be null (seen in the header's example bottom entry). Callers must handle null.
Stablecoins are filtered out of the leaderboard by the provider.

Response includes a _next block whose hints reference other paid Cryptyx per-asset endpoints (/api/asset/thesis, /api/asset/active-signals, /api/asset/asymmetry, /api/asset/regime-context, /api/v1/ai/trade-ideas) so an agent can drill from 'which asset' to the full stack in one hop.
The payment-required data (accepts + input/output schema) is delivered in the base64 'payment-required' HTTP header on the 402, matching the JSON body.
usage.guide: Daily crypto conviction leaderboard from Cryptyx. GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/market-pulse/conviction with an optional ?limit=N (integer 5-50, default 10) controlling how many assets per side. No body, no required params. Returns ok, asof_day (snapshot date), top[] and bottom[] arrays ranked by composite score. Each entry has asset, comp_score, comp_rank, ret_1d, ret_7d, funding_z, oi_roc_z, n_atomic, n_composite, sharpe_7d, thematic_scores (COMP_* 0..1), regime, and regime_confidence. Stablecoins are filtered. A _next block suggests paid per-asset follow-up endpoints. Pays $0.05 USDC via x402 on Base. Use it as a starting 'where to look' scan before drilling into a specific asset.

name: Cryptyx Market Pulse Divergences
description: Universe-aggregate cross-factor divergence alerts for the whole crypto market — Ignition (trend + volatility both extreme), Capitulation (flow + trend collapse), and Distribution (net outflows while trend holds) — severity-ranked by horizon for top-down scanning.

horizons.description: Optional comma-separated subset of 1d,7d,14d,30d,60d,90d,180d,365d. Invalid values silently dropped. Default: all 8 horizons.

usage.callShape: GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/market-pulse/divergences. All input is OPTIONAL query params: 'horizons' = comma-separated subset of 1d,7d,14d,30d,60d,90d,180d,365d (default: all 8). No request body, no required params. Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453).
usage.outputShape: Top-level: ok (bool), asof_day (YYYY-MM-DD snapshot date), total_alerts (int), by_type (map alert-type -> count, e.g. {ignition, capitulation, distribution}), by_horizon (map horizon -> alert[]), alerts (flat array of all alerts), durationMs, and _next (object with hints[] of recommended paid follow-up Cryptyx endpoints). Each alert: type (ignition|capitulation|distribution), label, horizon (e.g. 7d/30d/90d), classA and classB (the two factor classes diverging, e.g. TR, VOL, FLOW), scoreA, scoreB (factor z-scores/floats), color (hex), severity (float), relevance (float), interpretation (human-readable narrative).
quirks: GET with no required params — a bare call scans all 8 horizons; use ?horizons=7d,30d to narrow.

Universe-aggregate (whole-market) op — takes NO asset param; it surfaces which market-wide divergence conditions are firing, then you drill per-asset via the _next hints (conviction, factor-cross-section, asset/thesis, asset/asymmetry, ai/trade-ideas).
Response is a point-in-time daily snapshot keyed by asof_day; alert contents change day to day.
total_alerts can be 0 with empty by_type/by_horizon/alerts when no divergence conditions are firing (verified live 2026-07-29: 0 alerts). Callers must handle the empty state.
Three alert families: Ignition (TR+VOL both extreme -> momentum breakout), Capitulation (FLOW+TR collapse), Distribution (net outflows while trend holds -> late-cycle exit).
The payment-required data (accepts + input/output schema + a rich by_horizon example) is delivered in the base64 'payment-required' HTTP header on the 402; the 402 JSON body itself is empty ({}).
usage.guide: Market-wide crypto divergence scanner from Cryptyx. GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/market-pulse/divergences with an optional ?horizons=1d,7d,... (comma-separated subset of 1d,7d,14d,30d,60d,90d,180d,365d; default all 8). No body, no required params, no asset. Returns ok, asof_day (snapshot date), total_alerts, by_type (counts per Ignition/Capitulation/Distribution), by_horizon (alerts grouped by horizon), a flat alerts[] array, and a _next block of recommended paid Cryptyx follow-ups. Each alert carries type, horizon, the two diverging factor classes (classA/classB) with scoreA/scoreB, severity, relevance, and a plain-English interpretation. total_alerts may be 0 when nothing is firing. Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base. Use it as a top-down 'what is the whole market doing' scan before drilling into a named asset.

name: Cryptyx Factor Cross-Section
description: Factor term-structure grid: for each of 7 factor classes (CORR/EFF/FLOW/FUT/OB/TR/VOL) across 8 horizons (1d-365d), the market-average t-score with breadth counts (positive/negative asset counts) and a 1-day momentum delta — one matrix to read where factor rotation is happening.

mode.description: 'market' = aggregate grid across all assets; 'asset' = single-asset grid with per-cell delta vs market. Optional query param.

asset.description: Asset symbol, required only when mode=asset (e.g. BTC). Optional query param.

history_days.description: Sparkline lookback in days; 0 disables history. Optional query param.

history_class.description: Factor class for the sparkline (CORR/EFF/FLOW/FUT/OB/TR/VOL); required only with history_days>0. Optional query param.

history_horizon.description: Horizon for the sparkline (1d/7d/14d/30d/60d/90d/180d/365d); required only with history_days>0. Optional query param.

usage.callShape: GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/market-pulse/factor-cross-section. All input is OPTIONAL query params: 'mode' (market|asset, default market), 'asset' (symbol, required only if mode=asset), and an optional sparkline trio 'history_days' (0-90, default 0 = off), 'history_class' (CORR/EFF/FLOW/FUT/OB/TR/VOL) and 'history_horizon' (1d/7d/14d/30d/60d/90d/180d/365d) which are required together when history_days>0. No request body, no required params. Pays $0.05 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453).
usage.outputShape: Top-level: ok (bool), asof_day (YYYY-MM-DD snapshot date), mode ('market' or 'asset'), grid[] (56 cells = 7 classes x 8 horizons), durationMs, and a _next block. Each grid cell: class (CORR/EFF/FLOW/FUT/OB/TR/VOL), horizon (1d/7d/14d/30d/60d/90d/180d/365d), avg_t_score (market-average t-score, signed float), n_assets (assets contributing to the cell), positive_count / negative_count (breadth split), momentum_delta (1-day change in the cell's average). In mode=asset, cells additionally carry the asset's delta vs the market average. _next.hints[] each carry {path, method, price_usd, reason} pointing at follow-up paid Cryptyx endpoints (conviction, composite heatmap, asset thesis, asymmetry, trade-ideas).
quirks: GET with no required params — a bare call returns the full market-mode grid (56 cells).

Verified live 2026-07-29 (asof_day 2026-07-29): grid spans classes CORR/EFF/FLOW/FUT/OB/TR/VOL x horizons 1d/7d/14d/30d/60d/90d/180d/365d; response is a point-in-time daily snapshot keyed by asof_day, so values change day to day.
Horizon keys in the LIVE response are lowercase ('14d','180d','1d'), whereas the provider's 402 header example shows them uppercase ('14D'); treat horizon strings case-insensitively.
n_assets varies per cell (~140-198) because not every asset has data for every factor class/horizon.
mode=asset requires the 'asset' query param; omitting it while setting mode=asset will error — use mode=market (default) for the aggregate grid.

Response includes a _next block whose hints reference other paid Cryptyx endpoints (/api/market-pulse/conviction, /api/signals/composite/heatmap, /api/asset/thesis, /api/asset/asymmetry, /api/v1/ai/trade-ideas) so an agent can drill from the rotation matrix to specific assets/signals.
The payment-required data (accepts + bazaar input/output schema) is delivered in the base64 'payment-required' HTTP header on the 402; the plain 402 JSON body is empty ({}).
usage.guide: Factor term-structure grid from Cryptyx. GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/market-pulse/factor-cross-section with all-optional query params: mode=market (default) for the aggregate matrix across all assets, or mode=asset&asset=BTC for a single asset's grid with per-cell deltas vs market. Optionally add history_days (0-90) with history_class + history_horizon for a sparkline of one cell. No body. Returns ok, asof_day (snapshot date), mode, and grid[] of 56 cells (7 factor classes CORR/EFF/FLOW/FUT/OB/TR/VOL x 8 horizons 1d-365d); each cell has avg_t_score, n_assets, positive_count, negative_count and momentum_delta. Use it to read factor rotation across the whole crypto universe in one call, then follow _next hints to drill into specific assets/signals. Pays $0.05 USDC via x402 on Base.

name: Cryptyx Hero Timeline
description: Returns a bundled BTC market-pulse timeseries — BTC close price, macro regime label/confidence, and (in the signals layer) high-conviction signal density plus per-factor-class average scores — over a configurable 1-1900 day lookback, for orienting on where the crypto cycle stands.

layer.description: core (price + regime) or signals (adds signal density + per-factor-class scores). Default: core

outputSchema.description: Shape varies by layer. Verified layer=signals: { ok, density[{asof_day, n_hc_triggered}], series[{asof_day, class, avg_t_score}], durationMs, _next }. Documented layer=core (provider example): { ok, btc[{asof_day, close_px}], regime[{asof_day, regime_label, regime_confidence}], durationMs }.

usage.callShape: GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/market-pulse/hero-timeline with all-optional query params: days (1-1900, default 365), horizon (1d|7d|14d|30d|60d|90d|180d|365d, default 30d), layer (core|signals, default core). No request body. Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453). Result is inline in the 200 JSON (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: JSON object. Verified (layer=signals, days=30): { ok:true, density:[{asof_day:"2026-06-30", n_hc_triggered:782}, ...30 daily rows], series:[{asof_day, class:"FLOW"|"TR"|"VOL", avg_t_score:-0.11}, ...one row per class per day, 90 rows for 30d], durationMs:number, _next:{description, hints:[{path, method, price_usd, reason}]} }. The provider's documented layer=core (default) example instead returns btc:[{asof_day, close_px}] and regime:[{asof_day, regime_label, regime_confidence}] alongside ok/durationMs.
quirks: Output shape depends on the `layer` param: default `core` returns btc price + regime arrays; `signals` returns signal-density (`n_hc_triggered`) + per-factor-class `series` (class in FLOW/TR/VOL with avg_t_score) instead. Verified the signals layer live.
The signal-density field is named `n_hc_triggered` in the live signals-layer response (the provider's 402 example labels it `high_conviction_count`).
`series` in the live signals response is an ARRAY of per-factor-class daily rows, not the {horizon, layer} object shown in the 402 example.
`days` accepts 1-1900 even though the docs describe horizon up to 365d; row count scales with `days` (30d -> 30 density rows, 90 series rows).
Response includes a paid-endpoint `_next` recommendation block (sibling Cryptyx ops with prices) — informational, not part of the timeseries.
The 402 arrives even on a bare GET (no required param); all query params are optional with server defaults.
usage.guide: Call GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/market-pulse/hero-timeline; append ?days=N (1-1900) to set lookback, &horizon= to set the regime horizon, and &layer=signals to get signal-density + factor-class scores (omit or use layer=core for BTC price + regime history). No body, no auth key — pay the $0.01 x402 charge on Base. Read the result inline from the 200 JSON.

name: Cryptyx Regime Cell Context
description: Historical performance of one market-wide (horizon, regime_label) cell — how many times that regime has printed, its mean and hit-rate of 30-day forward returns, and the last 5 instances — answering 'when this regime showed up before, what happened next?' as a primitive for regime-conditional strategy backtesting.

horizon.description: Forward-return horizon of the cell. One of: 1d, 7d, 14d, 30d, 60d, 90d, 180d, 365d. Required.

label.description: Regime label of the cell (e.g. expansion, consolidation, deleveraging). Live data may use an uppercase REGIME_ prefix; treat as an opaque string. Required.

regime_label.description: Echoed regime label of the cell.

n_total.description: Total number of days this (horizon, regime_label) cell has printed historically.

n_r30.description: Number of those prints with a resolved 30-day forward return.

r30_mean.description: Mean 30-day forward return across the n_r30 prints (null when n_r30 is 0).

r30_hit.description: Hit rate (fraction with positive 30-day forward return), 0-1 (null when n_r30 is 0).

last_instances.description: Up to the last 5 instances of the cell. Each: { asof_day, duration_days, r30_return }.

_next.description: Recommended follow-up paid Cryptyx endpoints (hints[] with path/method/price_usd/reason).

usage.callShape: GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/market-pulse/regime-cell-context?horizon={horizon}&label={label}. REQUIRED query params: horizon (1d|7d|14d|30d|60d|90d|180d|365d) and label (regime label, e.g. expansion|consolidation|deleveraging). No request body. Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453). Result returned inline in the 200 (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: ok (bool); horizon (echoed); regime_label (echoed); n_total (total historical prints of the cell); n_r30 (prints with resolved 30d fwd return); r30_mean (mean 30d fwd return, null when n_r30=0); r30_hit (hit rate 0-1, null when n_r30=0); last_instances[] up to 5 { asof_day, duration_days, r30_return }; _next { description, hints[] } of recommended paid Cryptyx endpoints. Paid live (horizon=30d, label=expansion) -> HTTP 200 ok:true but an EMPTY cell (n_total=0, n_r30=0, r30_mean=null, r30_hit=null, last_instances=[]) — see quirks; the 402 bazaar output.example documents a populated cell shape (n_total 187, n_r30 152, r30_mean 0.084, r30_hit 0.612, last_instances with asof_day/duration_days/r30_return).
quirks: Both query params are REQUIRED: horizon AND label. A bare call (missing either) still returns a 402 challenge, but the paid call will not yield a meaningful cell without both — always supply both.
horizon accepts a wider set here than the per-asset endpoints: 1d, 7d, 14d, 30d, 60d, 90d, 180d, 365d (per the 402 bazaar input schema).

The paid live call with the provider's own documented example (horizon=30d, label=expansion) returned an EMPTY cell (n_total=0) even though the 402 output.example shows that same cell populated (n_total 187). Live regime labels come back with an uppercase REGIME_ prefix on sibling Cryptyx endpoints (e.g. REGIME_EXPANSION); the lowercase 'expansion' label likely does not match the stored label vocabulary, so pass the exact live label casing (discover it from /api/asset-regimes or /api/market-pulse/regime) to hit a populated cell.
r30_mean and r30_hit are null (not 0) when the cell has no resolved 30d forward returns (n_r30=0); guard for null before using them.
This is a MARKET-WIDE cell query (no asset input) — distinct from the per-asset /api/asset/regime-context which takes a symbol.
Response includes a _next.hints[] block advertising other paid Cryptyx endpoints (conviction, factor-cross-section, thesis, asymmetry, trade-ideas) at $0.05-$0.10; ignore unless chaining calls.
usage.guide: Cryptyx Regime Cell Context answers 'when this market regime showed up before at this horizon, what happened next?' in one paid call. GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/market-pulse/regime-cell-context?horizon=30d&label=expansion — BOTH query params are required: horizon (1d|7d|14d|30d|60d|90d|180d|365d) and label (a regime label). No request body; pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base. It returns the number of historical prints of that (horizon, regime_label) cell (n_total), how many have a resolved 30d forward return (n_r30), the mean 30d forward return (r30_mean) and hit-rate (r30_hit), and the last 5 instances (asof_day, duration_days, r30_return) — a primitive for regime-conditional strategy backtesting. Important: use the EXACT live regime label casing (live labels carry an uppercase REGIME_ prefix, e.g. REGIME_EXPANSION; discover it via /api/asset-regimes or /api/market-pulse/regime) or the cell comes back empty (n_total=0, r30_mean/r30_hit null). Guard for null stats when n_r30 is 0.

name: Cryptyx Market Regime Divergence
description: For one crypto asset, how out-of-step its regime cascade is with the broader market — per-horizon (1d..365d) market vs asset regime labels, a score delta, the diverging horizons, a severity rating, and a one-line interpretation.

asset.description: Asset symbol to drill into (e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL). Optional; defaults to BTC.

market.description: Market-wide regime cascade: cascade[] of {horizon,regime_label,bias} across 1d..365d, plus supertrend_score and supertrend_label.

asset_cascade.description: The asset's own regime cascade: cascade[] of {horizon,regime_label,bias} across 1d..365d, plus supertrend_score and supertrend_label.

divergence.description: { score_delta (number, asset vs market), diverging_horizons (string[]), severity (mild|...|high), interpretation (human-readable) }.

usage.callShape: GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/market-pulse/regime-divergence?asset=BTC. Single OPTIONAL query param 'asset' = symbol (BTC, ETH, SOL, ...; default BTC). No request body. Pays $0.05 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453).
usage.outputShape: Top-level: ok (bool), asof_day (YYYY-MM-DD snapshot date), asset (echoed symbol). market = { cascade: array of { horizon (1d/7d/14d/30d/60d/90d/180d/365d), regime_label (e.g. DIVERGENT/CHOPPY/BROAD_EXPANSION), bias (risk_on/neutral/risk_off) }, supertrend_score (0-100), supertrend_label }. asset_cascade = same shape for the queried asset. divergence = { score_delta (number: >0 asset ahead of market, <0 behind), diverging_horizons (string[] of horizons where they disagree), severity (e.g. mild/high), interpretation (one-line narrative) }. _next = { description, hints[] of recommended paid follow-up Cryptyx endpoints with path/method/price_usd/reason }.

divergence.interpretation: BTC is running ahead of the market — Oversold Reversal at 60d and Accumulation at 7d on BTC's cascade while the broader market hasn't rotated yet.

quirks: Single optional query param 'asset' (default BTC) — a bare GET returns BTC vs market; pass ?asset=ETH etc. to drill into another symbol.
Asset-level DRILL-IN companion to the universe-wide /api/market-pulse/divergences: this answers 'where is THIS asset out-of-step with the macro?', the other scans the whole universe.

market.cascade and asset_cascade.cascade are ARRAYS of {horizon,regime_label,bias} across the 8 horizons 1d/7d/14d/30d/60d/90d/180d/365d (the older bazaar example showed a smaller {7d,30d,90d} object — trust the live array shape).
regime_label is an enum-like free-form string (observed: DIVERGENT, CHOPPY, BROAD_EXPANSION, ACCUMULATION, OVERSOLD_REVERSAL, VOLATILITY_REGIME); bias is risk_on/neutral/risk_off.
divergence.score_delta is signed: positive = asset running ahead of the market, negative = asset lagging; severity summarizes magnitude (mild..high).
Response is a point-in-time daily snapshot keyed by asof_day; contents change day to day.

The payment-required data (accepts + bazaar input/output schema + example) is delivered in the base64 'payment-required' HTTP header on the 402; the 402 JSON body itself is empty ({}). The paid 200 carries the real result inline (no polling).
usage.guide: Cryptyx Market Regime Divergence measures how out-of-step one crypto asset is with the broader market's regime. GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/market-pulse/regime-divergence?asset=BTC (asset optional, defaults to BTC; use ETH/SOL/etc for other symbols). No body. Returns ok, asof_day, asset, and two regime cascades: market (the whole market) and asset_cascade (the queried asset), each a cascade[] of {horizon (1d..365d), regime_label, bias} plus a supertrend_score/label. The divergence block gives score_delta (signed: >0 asset ahead of market, <0 behind), diverging_horizons[], severity, and a plain-English interpretation. A _next block lists recommended paid Cryptyx follow-ups (conviction, factor-cross-section, asset/thesis, asset/asymmetry, ai/trade-ideas). Pays $0.05 USDC via x402 on Base. Use it to check whether a specific asset is leading or lagging the macro regime before sizing a position.

name: Cryptyx Market Regime
description: Multi-horizon macro regime synthesis for the crypto market from 1d through 365d — per-horizon regime label, confidence, cross-class risk-on/off state, factor-class breadth, and horizon alignment across ~198 assets, plus a rolling history timeline.

inputSchema.description: All query params optional. days (int) = history window; horizon (string, e.g. 7d/30d) to focus a single horizon; slim (bool) drops the large history/timeline blobs for a smaller payload.

current.description: Map keyed by horizon (1d,7d,14d,30d,60d,90d,180d,365d); each value has regime_label, regime_confidence, cross_class_state, breadth (per factor-class net_score/expanding_pct/contracting_pct/n_assets), horizon_alignment (per class 1d..365d scores + state), n_assets, meta{dominant_classes,weakest_class}.

usage.callShape: GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/market-pulse/regime. No request body and NO required input — a bare GET returns the full current regime across all horizons. Optional query params: days (int history window), horizon (string, focus one horizon e.g. 30d), slim (bool, drop the large history timeline for a smaller payload). Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453).
usage.outputShape: ok (bool); asof_day (date); current = map keyed by horizon (1d,7d,14d,30d,60d,90d,180d,365d), each { regime_label (e.g. DIVERGENT/expansion/consolidation), regime_confidence (0-1), cross_class_state (risk_on/neutral/DIVERGENT), breadth = map keyed by factor-class code (OB,TR,EFF,FUT,VOL,CORR,FLOW) of { n_assets, net_score, expanding_pct, contracting_pct }, horizon_alignment = per factor-class { 1d..365d scores, state } , n_assets, meta { dominant_classes[], weakest_class } }; history = array of per-horizon-per-day records (asof_day, horizon, regime_label, regime_confidence, breadth, horizon_alignment, cross_class_state, n_assets, meta); count (int, number of history records).
quirks: No required input: a bare GET is a valid, payable call — days/horizon/slim are all optional.
Full (non-slim) response is large (~460KB / count=240 history records across 8 horizons); pass slim=true to drop the history/timeline blobs when you only need the current posture.

Regime labels and cross_class_state are enum-like strings that vary by market state (observed DIVERGENT with regime_confidence 0.2 and cross_class_state DIVERGENT); the bazaar example uses lowercase labels (expansion/consolidation, risk_on) — treat labels as free-form strings.
breadth/horizon_alignment are keyed by factor-class codes (OB, TR, EFF, FUT, VOL, CORR, FLOW), not by asset symbol.
n_assets is ~192-198 per class (universe coverage), not a fixed value.
usage.guide: Cryptyx Market Regime gives the crypto market's overall macro regime across every horizon (1d..365d) in one paid call. GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/market-pulse/regime with no body and no required params (a bare GET works). Optional query params: days (history window), horizon (focus a single horizon like 30d), slim=true (drop the large history timeline for a compact current-posture payload). Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base. Response: ok, asof_day, and current — a map keyed by horizon where each horizon carries regime_label, regime_confidence, cross_class_state (risk-on/off/divergent), breadth per factor-class (OB/TR/EFF/FUT/VOL/CORR/FLOW with net_score + expanding/contracting pct), horizon_alignment per class, n_assets and meta{dominant_classes,weakest_class}; plus a history array (count records) for timelines. Use slim=true unless you need the full history.

name: Cryptyx Temporal Layers
description: Decomposes crypto market regime into tactical / strategic / secular layers plus a 0-100 Supertrend score across a 1-1900 day lookback, revealing whether the horizons agree or diverge.

days.description: Lookback window in days (1-1900, default 90). Optional query param.

history.description: Daily rows: { date, supertrend_score, tactical_label, strategic_label, secular_label }

usage.callShape: GET with an optional ?days= query param (1-1900, default 90); no request body. Bare GET is payable. Whole-market (not per-asset) — takes no asset param.
usage.outputShape: JSON: { ok, current: { day, tactical|strategic|secular: { label, active, confidence, since_days }, supertrend_score }, history: [ { date, supertrend_score, tactical_label, strategic_label, secular_label } ], count, durationMs }. Regime labels observed: CHOPPY, DIVERGENT, RISK_OFF_DEFENSIVE, BROAD_EXPANSION, VOLATILITY_REGIME, ACCUMULATION, OVERSOLD_REVERSAL. supertrend_score is 0-100.
usage.quirks: Market-wide regime, not per-asset — takes no asset param. `days` is optional (default 90) and sets both the current snapshot and the length of the daily history array (count == days). Response also includes a `_next` block of recommended paid Cryptyx endpoints. Single accept: Base (eip155:8453) USDC only, no Solana lane.
usage.guide: Call GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/market-pulse/temporal-layers optionally with ?days=<1-1900> (default 90). Pay the x402 402 challenge with USDC on Base ($0.01). Read `current` for the live tactical/strategic/secular regime labels and `supertrend_score`, and `history` for the daily regime timeline over the lookback.

name: Cryptyx Market Pulse
description: Universe-wide crypto factor breadth bucketed by factor class and horizon across 200+ assets — per (horizon, class) positive/negative/neutral counts, total, average t-score, expand-share percent, factor state (EXPANSION/COMPRESSION/NEUTRAL) and dominant regime id, timing risk-on/off rotations.

inputSchema.description: All query params optional (a bare GET is valid). mode = 'series' (full lookback window, default) or 'snapshot' (latest day only, ordered by horizon, class). days = lookback window in days, 1-1825 (default 30). horizons = comma-separated horizons to filter, e.g. '7D,30D,180D' (empty = all). classes = comma-separated factor classes to filter from CORR,EFF,FLOW,FUT,OB,OPT,TR,VOL (empty = all).

rows.description: One record per (asof_day, horizon, class): { asof_day (date), horizon (e.g. 7D/30D), class (factor class code), positive_count, negative_count, neutral_count, total, avg_t_score, expand_share_pct, factor_state (EXPANSION/COMPRESSION/NEUTRAL), dominant_regime_id }.

_next.description: Recommended next paid x402 calls given the response (path/method/price_usd/reason hints).

usage.callShape: GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/market-pulse. No request body and NO required input — a bare GET returns the full factor-breadth series. Optional query params: mode (series default | snapshot = latest day only), days (int lookback window 1-1825, default 30), horizons (comma-separated e.g. '7D,30D', empty = all), classes (comma-separated from CORR,EFF,FLOW,FUT,OB,OPT,TR,VOL, empty = all). Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453).
usage.outputShape: rows = array of { asof_day (date), horizon (e.g. 7D/30D/180D), class (factor-class code: CORR/EFF/FLOW/FUT/OB/OPT/TR/VOL), positive_count, negative_count, neutral_count, total (~198 universe assets), avg_t_score (float), expand_share_pct (float 0-100), factor_state (EXPANSION/COMPRESSION/NEUTRAL), dominant_regime_id (int) }; latest_day (date string); _next = { description, hints[] } of recommended follow-on paid endpoints (path, method, price_usd, reason).
quirks: No required input: a bare GET is a valid, payable call — mode/days/horizons/classes are all optional.

mode=snapshot returns only the latest day's rows; on the paid live call (mode=snapshot, horizons=7D,30D, classes=TR,VOL) rows came back empty because the very latest day (latest_day) was not yet computed under those filters — use mode=series (the default) or widen the filters to get populated rows.
Factor-class codes are CORR, EFF, FLOW, FUT, OB, OPT, TR, VOL; factor_state is an enum-like string (EXPANSION/COMPRESSION/NEUTRAL).
total is the universe size (~198 assets) so positive+negative+neutral sum to total per (horizon,class) row.
Response carries a _next block of provider-recommended follow-on paid x402 endpoints (conviction, factor-cross-section, asset/thesis, asset/asymmetry, ai/trade-ideas) — informational, not required.
usage.guide: Cryptyx Market Pulse gives the crypto market's universe-wide factor breadth in one paid call — how many of ~200 assets are positive/negative/neutral per factor class and horizon, plus average t-score, expand-share % and the dominant regime, for timing risk-on/off rotations. GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/market-pulse with no body and no required params (a bare GET works). Optional query params: mode (series default = full lookback, or snapshot = latest day only), days (lookback window 1-1825, default 30), horizons (e.g. '7D,30D,180D'), classes (subset of CORR,EFF,FLOW,FUT,OB,OPT,TR,VOL). Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base. Response: rows[] of per-(asof_day,horizon,class) breadth records (positive/negative/neutral counts, total, avg_t_score, expand_share_pct, factor_state, dominant_regime_id), latest_day, and a _next block of recommended follow-on paid endpoints. Prefer mode=series (default) for populated data; snapshot can be empty on the freshest day.

name: Cryptyx Metric Preview
description: Lightweight 90-day z-score timeseries for one (metric_id, asset): per-day asof_day, z-score, and percentile — a cheap primitive for sparklines, chart tooltips, or rapid metric due-diligence before a full /metrics/slicer backtest.

inputSchema.description: Query params. metric_id (string, required) = a metric ID from the Cryptyx catalog, e.g. TR_MOMO_CONT_14D or TR_ROC_180D. asset (string, required) = asset symbol, uppercased server-side, e.g. BTC. days (number, optional) = lookback window 7-365, default 90.

metric_id.description: Metric ID from the catalog (e.g. TR_MOMO_CONT_14D)

asset.description: Asset symbol (uppercased server-side)

outputSchema.description: ok flag, echoed metric_id + asset, latest asof_day, and a points[] array of {asof_day, z, pctl} per day.

usage.callShape: GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/metrics/preview with required query params metric_id and asset (and optional days); result is returned inline in the 200 JSON body.
usage.outputShape: { ok: boolean, metric_id: string, asset: string, asof_day: string|null, points: [{ asof_day: string, z: number, pctl: number }] }
usage.quirks: metric_id must be a valid ID from the Cryptyx catalog (e.g. TR_MOMO_CONT_14D, TR_ROC_180D — 440+ metrics across 8 factor classes); an unknown metric_id or a metric with no data for the asset returns a 200 with ok:true but an empty points[] (as happened on the verified TR_MOMO_CONT_14D/BTC call). Pick an active metric_id for the target asset to get populated points. The 200 body also carries a _next block of recommended paid endpoints (advisory only).
usage.needs: A valid metric_id (from the paid /api/signals/catalog or /api/metrics/slicer/scan) and an asset symbol.
usage.guide: GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/metrics/preview?metric_id=<CATALOG_METRIC_ID>&asset=<SYMBOL> (optional &days=7..365, default 90). Pay the $0.01 x402 challenge (USDC on Base). The 200 body returns the 90-day z-score/percentile timeseries inline under points[]. Use a metric_id known to be active for the asset — a valid-but-unpopulated metric returns ok:true with empty points[].

name: Cryptyx Composite Metric Backtest
description: Multi-factor z-score confluence backtest for one asset: supply 2-4 (metric_id, operator, threshold) conditions and get the intersected trigger days, per-metric z timeseries, and per-horizon (1d-365d, 8 horizons) forward-return and max-drawdown stats — validate a confluence stack before live deployment.

asset.description: Asset symbol (case-insensitive, uppercased server-side). Example: BTC, ETH, SOL.

conditions.description: 2-4 condition objects that must all trigger on the same day (confluence). Each: { metric_id (a real metric from the 440+ catalog, e.g. TR_ROC_7D, VOL_RV_7D, CORR_BTC_180D), operator (gt|lt|gte|lte|abs_gt), threshold (z-score number) }.

metric_id.description: Metric ID from the 440+ catalog. NOTE: signal_ids from the signals registry are NOT metric_ids.

operator.description: Trigger comparator vs threshold: gt, lt, gte, lte, or abs_gt.

cooldown_days.description: Optional. Integer 0-365, default 7. Suppresses repeat composite triggers within N days of the last accepted trigger.

usage.callShape: POST https://cryptyx.ai/api/metrics/slicer/composite with a JSON body. Required: asset (string ticker), conditions (array of 2-4 objects, each { metric_id (string, from the 440+ metric catalog), operator (one of gt/lt/gte/lte/abs_gt), threshold (number, z-score) }). Optional: cooldown_days (integer 0-365, default 7). All conditions must trigger on the same day for a composite trigger. Pays $0.05 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453). Synchronous — the full backtest result is returned inline in the 200.
usage.outputShape: Top-level: ok (bool), params (echoed asset/cooldown_days/conditions), metricSeries[] (one per condition metric: {metric_id, timeseries[{asof_day, z, pctl, triggered}]}), priceSeries[] ({asof_day, close_px}), compositeTriggeredDays[] (date strings where ALL conditions triggered), triggers[] (per composite-trigger day: {asof_day, metrics{<metric_id>:{z,pctl}}, fwd_1d/7d/14d/30d/60d/90d/180d/365d forward returns, max_dd_1d..365d max-drawdowns}), summary {n_observations, n_triggers, n_triggers_raw, n_suppressed, trigger_rate, horizons{1d..365d each with n, mean_return, median_return, max_return, min_return, std_return, hit_rate, sharpe, max_dd_mean, max_dd_p95, max_dd_worst}, perMetric{<metric_id>:{n_triggers, trigger_rate}}}, durationMs, _next.hints[] each {path, method, price_usd, reason} pointing at follow-up paid Cryptyx endpoints. Verified live: asset BTC with TR_ROC_7D/VOL_RV_7D returned 1932 observations, 131 composite trigger days, and full 8-horizon stats.
quirks: POST with a JSON body (NOT query params). Required fields are asset and conditions; conditions must hold 2-4 objects, each { metric_id, operator, threshold }. cooldown_days is optional (default 7).

Each metric_id must be a real METRIC from the 440+ metrics catalog (e.g. TR_ROC_7D, VOL_RV_7D, CORR_BTC_180D), NOT a signal_id from the signals registry — a signal_id yields ok:true but empty timeseries/triggers. Discover valid metric_ids via the paid GET /api/signals/catalog and metrics endpoints.

'Confluence' = intersection: a composite trigger day requires EVERY condition to trigger on that same day, so compositeTriggeredDays is typically far fewer than any single metric's own trigger count (see summary.perMetric).

Verified live 2026-07-30 (paid $0.05): POST {asset:BTC, conditions:[{TR_ROC_7D,abs_gt,1.5},{VOL_RV_7D,lt,1}], cooldown_days:0} -> 200 ok:true, n_observations 1932, 131 composite triggers, trigger_rate 0.0678, full per-horizon forward-return/drawdown stats.

A metric/asset pair with no z-score data still returns HTTP 200 ok:true with empty arrays and n_observations reflecting available history — callers should check summary.n_observations / summary.n_triggers before trusting the stats.

The response body is large (~500KB) because metricSeries and priceSeries carry the full multi-year daily z/price history; agents that only need the stats can read summary + compositeTriggeredDays and ignore the raw series.
The payment challenge (accepts + full input/output example + JSON schema) is delivered in the base64 'payment-required' HTTP header on the 402, matching openapi.json.
Forward-return and drawdown stats span 8 horizons (1d, 7d, 14d, 30d, 60d, 90d, 180d, 365d) and require 5+ years of history per asset.

Response includes a _next block whose hints reference other paid Cryptyx endpoints so an agent can drill from a confluence backtest into the signal registry, top signals, per-asset predictors, thesis, or ranked trade ideas.
needs: 2-4 valid metric_ids from the Cryptyx metrics catalog (e.g. TR_ROC_7D, VOL_RV_7D, CORR_BTC_180D) — a signal_id will return empty data.
usage.guide: Cryptyx multi-factor z-score confluence backtest. POST https://cryptyx.ai/api/metrics/slicer/composite with JSON {asset, conditions:[2-4 x {metric_id, operator, threshold}], cooldown_days?}. Every metric_id must be a real metric from the 440+ catalog (e.g. TR_ROC_7D, VOL_RV_7D, CORR_BTC_180D) — signal_ids return empty data. operator is one of gt/lt/gte/lte/abs_gt; threshold is a z-score; cooldown_days (0-365, default 7) suppresses clustered triggers. A composite trigger day requires ALL conditions to fire on the same day. Returns ok, echoed params, per-metric daily z timeseries, a price series, the composite trigger days with per-horizon forward returns and max drawdowns (1d-365d, 8 horizons), and a summary with trigger_rate, per-horizon hit_rate/sharpe/return stats, and per-metric trigger counts. name: Cryptyx Signal Evaluator
description: Invokes Cryptyx's DB-side signal evaluator for one anchor day: dryrun mode predicts how many rows a signal would trigger without writing, while live mode executes the evaluation and inserts rows into the signal_log — a backfill primitive for missed pipeline days and a validation primitive for forked parameter variants.

queryParams.day: Anchor day in YYYY-MM-DD format. REQUIRED.
queryParams.signal_id: Optional signal identifier (uppercased server-side, e.g. TR_MOMO_CONT_14D). If omitted, evaluates ALL enabled signals via signal_eval_all_for_day (a live write, dryrun is ignored).
queryParams.dryrun: Optional 'true' or 'false' (default 'false'). When 'true' AND signal_id is provided, counts would-trigger rows via signal_dryrun_count WITHOUT writing to signal_log. Ignored when signal_id is omitted.

_next.description: Recommended next paid x402 Cryptyx calls

usage.callShape: GET https://cryptyx.ai/api/signals/eval?day=<YYYY-MM-DD>&signal_id=<SIGNAL_ID>&dryrun=true — day is REQUIRED. To PREDICT trigger counts without any DB write, pass BOTH signal_id (a valid signal id such as TR_MOMO_CONT_14D) AND dryrun=true. Omitting signal_id (or leaving dryrun=false) LIVE-EXECUTES the evaluation and writes rows to signal_log. Pay-per-call over x402 (exact scheme, USDC on Base, $0.05).

quirks: MUTATING BY DEFAULT: dryrun defaults to 'false' and, per the provider's own bazaar-extension schema, dryrun is IGNORED when signal_id is omitted — a bare day-only call runs signal_eval_all_for_day and WRITES to signal_log. The only non-mutating invocation is signal_id + dryrun=true; that is what was paid to verify.
day is the only REQUIRED query param; signal_id and dryrun are optional but must both be present for a safe dry run.

signal_id is uppercased server-side; valid ids come from Cryptyx's own signal catalog / 402 output example (e.g. TR_MOMO_CONT_14D, EFF_KEY_REVERSAL_1D, FLOW_VWAP_DEV_7D, FUT_FUNDING_STRESS, TR_ROC_180D, VOL_COMPRESSION_7v30) — GET /api/signals/catalog enumerates them.
The 402 details (accepts + input/output schema + example) live in the response's payment-required HEADER (base64 x402 v2 envelope with an extensions.bazaar block), not the JSON body (body is {}).
Every response carries a _next block of recommended follow-on paid Cryptyx endpoints (signals/explain, signals/catalog, signals/top, asset/thesis, v1/ai/trade-ideas).
The provider openapi.json at /api/openapi.json is auth-gated (401 Unauthorized); the public /openapi.json copy plus the live 402 bazaar-extension schema supplied the full call shape.
Vercel-hosted serverless function; a bare probe without the required day param can return HTTP 500 (needsParams) rather than 402 — supply day to get the payment challenge.

To safely PREDICT how many rows a signal would trigger without writing anything, pass BOTH signal_id=<SIGNAL_ID> (e.g. TR_MOMO_CONT_14D, from /api/signals/catalog) AND dryrun=true — you get {ok, signal_id, day, dryrun:true, wouldTrigger, durationMs}.
