name: Agentstools Governance Proposal
description: Fetch one Snapshot governance proposal by its proposal_id and get deterministic governance semantics computed on top of it — quorum progress and whether quorum is met, the leading choice and its margin, participation (vote count and total voting power), seconds remaining, an honest outcome projection (current leader, not a final result), the top voters, and a structured digest.

proposal.description: Normalized Snapshot proposal: id, space, space_name, title, state, choices[], scores[], scores_total, quorum, votes_count, start, end, author, snapshot_block, strategies_summary[], link

semantics.description: Deterministic governance signals: quorum_progress, quorum_met, leading_choice, leading_share, margin{leader,runner_up,score_gap,share_gap}, participation{votes_count,voting_power_total,quorum,quorum_progress}, time_remaining_sec, outcome_projection{leading_choice,leading_share,quorum_met,state,is_final,caveat}, top_voters[]{voter,choice,choice_label,vp,reason,created}, digest{title,body_excerpt,body_truncated,current_tally[],leading_choice}

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/governance/proposal with one query param: proposal_id (REQUIRED — a Snapshot proposal id, 0x… hex). No request body. Pays $0.02 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453). Result returned inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: { proposal{ id, space, space_name, title, state, choices[], scores[], scores_total, quorum, votes_count, start, end, author, snapshot_block, strategies_summary[], link }, semantics{ quorum_progress, quorum_met, leading_choice, leading_share, margin{leader,runner_up,score_gap,share_gap}, participation{votes_count,voting_power_total,quorum,quorum_progress}, time_remaining_sec, outcome_projection{leading_choice,leading_share,quorum_met,state,is_final,caveat}, top_voters[]{voter,choice,choice_label,vp,reason,created}, digest{title,body_excerpt,body_truncated,current_tally[]{choice,score},leading_choice} }, attribution[], disclaimer }. Verified live example (paid 200): proposal 'uniswapgovernance.eth' / '[Temp Check] Activate v4 Protocol Fees', state 'closed', choices ['For','Against','Abstain'], scores_total 20316661.0, quorum 10000000, votes_count 132; semantics.quorum_met true, quorum_progress 2.031666, leading_choice 'For' (leading_share 0.9506), 10 top_voters, digest.current_tally per choice.
quirks: proposal_id is the only query param and is REQUIRED — a Snapshot proposal id (0x… hex, from a proposal's page/URL or from the sibling /governance/proposals list op).

semantics is computed deterministically (no LLM): quorum_progress can exceed 1.0 when voting power passes quorum; time_remaining_sec goes negative for closed proposals; outcome_projection.is_final is true only once state='closed'.
Governance data is proxied from Snapshot Hub (snapshot.org GraphQL API); attribution echoed in the body. Provider labels it DAO-governance data/signals, not voting or financial advice.
The 402/bazaar schema lists method enum GET/HEAD/DELETE, but the meaningful data read is GET.
Distinct from the plural /governance/proposals op, which lists a whole space's proposals by space-id and returns no per-proposal semantics.
usage.guide: Read one Snapshot governance proposal plus deterministic vote semantics in a single paid call. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/governance/proposal?proposal_id=0x… (proposal_id is required — a Snapshot proposal id in hex, e.g. from a snapshot.box proposal URL or the /governance/proposals list op). Pays $0.02 USDC via x402 on Base. Returns the normalized proposal (title, state, choices, scores, quorum, votes_count, start/end, author, snapshot_block, link) alongside a semantics block: quorum_progress and quorum_met, leading_choice with its share and margin, participation (votes + total voting power), seconds remaining, an honest outcome_projection (current leader, flagged is_final only when closed), the top voters, and a digest with a body excerpt and current tally. Live-paid and verified at index time against Uniswap's '[Temp Check] Activate v4 Protocol Fees' (closed, quorum met, 'For' leading).

name: Agentstools Governance Votes
description: Normalized per-voter ballot on a Snapshot DAO proposal, ordered by voting power (highest first): each vote carries the voter address, the raw choice index AND its resolved human label (For/Against/Abstain mapped from the proposal's choices), the voting power behind it, any reason text the voter left, and the unix timestamp — for tracking how delegates and large holders are voting. Sourced from Snapshot Hub.

proposal_id.description: Snapshot proposal id (0x… hex) (query param). Required.

limit.description: Max votes to return (query param), default 20, cap 50.

choice.description: Raw 1-based choice index. Complex ballots (approval/ranked/weighted) keep their raw choice payload.

choice_label.description: Human label mapped from the proposal's choices (e.g. 'For'); null for complex ballots that can't be single-labelled.

reason.description: Reason text the voter left, or null.

created.description: Unix timestamp the vote was cast.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/governance/votes?proposal_id=<0x…hex>&limit=<N> — proposal_id (Snapshot 0x hex id) is a REQUIRED query param; limit (1-50, default 20) is optional. No request body, no API key. First call returns HTTP 402 with an x402 challenge in the `payment-required` response HEADER (base64 x402 v2; the 402 body is an empty {}); settling it returns HTTP 200 with the votes inline (synchronous, no poll). A missing/invalid proposal returns 422, an upstream Snapshot failure 502.
usage.outputShape: JSON: {proposal_id, choices:[label,...], count, votes:[{voter, choice(int), choice_label(str|null), vp(number), reason(str|null), created(unix)}], attribution:[...], disclaimer}. Votes are ordered by voting power, highest first. LIVE PAID RESULT (2026-08-07, proposal_id=0x3fda…d5f4&limit=20): HTTP 200, $0.008 charged, count:20, choices ['For','Against','Abstain'] — the Uniswap 'Activate v4 Protocol Fees' temp check; top vote 0x6d71…75C3 'For' vp 8,007,642, one 'Against' from 0x4905…4DD0 (vp 1,000,000) with a linked rationale, one 'Abstain'; attribution 'Governance data from Snapshot Hub'.
quirks: proposal_id (Snapshot 0x hex id) is REQUIRED; limit is optional (1-50, default 20, hard cap 50).
Fixed price $0.008 (amount 8000, USDC 6 decimals on Base eip155:8453); not dynamic.
402 challenge is delivered in the `payment-required` response HEADER (base64 x402 v2), not the body — the 402 body is an empty {}.

Votes are ordered by voting power (highest first); each carries both the raw `choice` index and a resolved `choice_label`. Complex ballots (approval/ranked/weighted) keep their raw choice payload and carry a null label rather than being mislabelled.
Read-only; SSRF-safe (upstream Snapshot host is fixed, caller passes only id + limit). Missing proposal -> HTTP 422, upstream failure -> HTTP 502.

Distinct same-host operation, NOT an alias: /governance/proposal ($0.02) returns ONE proposal plus deterministic aggregate semantics (quorum progress, leading choice, margin, outcome projection, top voters, digest). Use this /governance/votes route for the full per-voter ballot list; use /governance/proposal for the tallied summary.
usage.guide: Get the per-voter ballot on a Snapshot DAO proposal to see how delegates and large holders are actually voting. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/governance/votes with proposal_id=<0x…hex Snapshot proposal id> (required) and optional limit (1-50, default 20). No body, no API key. Pays $0.008 USDC via x402 on Base (challenge in the `payment-required` header). Returns votes ordered by voting power — each with voter address, raw choice index, resolved choice label (For/Against/Abstain), voting power, any reason text, and timestamp — plus the proposal's choice labels and Snapshot attribution. Verified live 2026-08-07 (paid 200, $0.008; returned 20 votes on the Uniswap v4-protocol-fees temp check). For the aggregate tally/quorum/projection instead of the raw ballot, use the sibling /governance/proposal route.

name: Agentstools Basename Resolve
description: Resolve Base names (Basenames, the *.base.eth ENS fork) on-chain via the L2Resolver: forward lookup (name -> address) or reverse lookup (address -> primary name), where the reverse result is forward-verified against spoofing (the returned name must resolve back to the queried address).

name.description: Basename/ENS name to resolve (forward lookup name -> address), e.g. jesse.base.eth. Expected normalized/lowercase (no ENSIP-15 in MVP).

address.description: Address for reverse lookup (address -> primary name); best-effort and forward-verified against spoofing.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/resolve with query params. Supply EXACTLY ONE of: name (Basename/ENS name for a forward lookup name -> address, e.g. jesse.base.eth) OR address (for a reverse lookup address -> primary name). No request body. Pays $0.005 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453). Result returned inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll). The 402 quote arrives in the payment-required header (base64 JSON); the 402 body is empty ({}).
usage.outputShape: query (the input echoed); direction ('forward' | 'reverse'); name (resolved/queried Basename); address (resolved/queried 0x address); chain (CAIP-2, e.g. eip155:8453); ts (unix seconds); cached (bool). Forward returns the address for a name; reverse returns the primary name for an address (forward-verified).
quirks: All input is query params; no request body. Supply EITHER name (forward name -> address) OR address (reverse address -> name), not both.
Reverse lookup is best-effort and forward-verified against spoofing: the returned name is only given if it resolves back to the queried address.
Input is expected normalized/lowercase (no ENSIP-15 normalization in the MVP), so pass already-lowercased names.
Basenames are the *.base.eth ENS fork on Base, resolved on-chain via the L2Resolver; chain is always eip155:8453.
cached flags whether the result was served from cache. Verified live 2026-08-07: name=jesse.base.eth -> 0x2211d1D0020DAEA8039E46Cf1367962070d77DA9 (HTTP 200, $0.005 charged).
usage.guide: Resolve a Base name to an address or vice versa in one paid call. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/resolve?name=<basename> for a forward lookup (name -> address), or GET https://api.agentstools.dev/resolve?address=<0x...> for a reverse lookup (address -> primary Basename, forward-verified against spoofing). No request body; pass lowercased/normalized input. Pays $0.005 USDC via x402 on Base (no API key). Returns {query, direction, name, address, chain, ts, cached} inline in the 200 (synchronous). Use it to turn a *.base.eth Basename into a payable/lookupable 0x address, or to label an address with its primary Basename. Verified live: name=jesse.base.eth -> 0x2211d1D0020DAEA8039E46Cf1367962070d77DA9.

name: Agentstools RWA Yield
description: Focused yield read for a single tokenized real-world-asset (RWA) product from the DefiLlama yields feed: every tracked pool with its current APY, base/reward APY split, 30-day mean APY and 30-day change, plus a TVL-weighted average APY across the product's pools. Resolves the product by DefiLlama slug or token symbol; reports availability false when the product has no tracked pools rather than inventing a figure.

slug.description: DefiLlama product slug (the join key returned by rwa/list)

symbol.description: Token symbol, an alternative to slug

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/rwa/yield?slug=<DefiLlama-slug> (or ?symbol=<TICKER> as an alternative). No request body, no API key. Both query params are optional in the schema but one is needed to resolve a product. First call returns HTTP 402 with an x402 v2 quote (USDC on Base eip155:8453); settling it returns HTTP 200 with the yield facet inline (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: slug, name, symbol, issuer, sub_category, then yield{available (bool), project, pool_count (int), avg_apy (TVL-weighted average, number), total_pool_tvl_usd (number), pools[] (each: pool id, project, symbol, chain, tvlUsd, apy, apyBase, apyReward (nullable), apyMean30d, apyPct30D), attribution (string)}, plus top-level provenance{source,dataset}, attribution[] and disclaimer. When the product has no tracked pools yield.available is false.
quirks: Resolve a product name/issuer to its DefiLlama slug first via the cheaper /rwa/list route; then feed the slug here (or use ?symbol=<TICKER>)
avg_apy is a TVL-weighted average across all of the product's tracked pools — an honest single number, not a simple mean
yield.available is false (rather than a fabricated figure) when DefiLlama tracks no pools for the product
402 is x402 v2: the response BODY is empty ({}) and the quote (accepts) lives in the base64-encoded payment-required response HEADER
Unknown product returns 404, an upstream failure 502 (never a 500)
Data is a DERIVED signal from DefiLlama Yields open data — the response carries an explicit not-financial-advice disclaimer that should be shown
usage.guide: Get pool-level yield/APY for a tokenized real-world-asset product, ideal for comparing carry across treasuries and private credit. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/rwa/yield?slug=<DefiLlama-slug> (or ?symbol=<TICKER>). No body, no API key. Pays $0.008 USDC via x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453). Resolve a name to its slug first via the cheaper /rwa/list route. The 200 body carries yield{available, pool_count, avg_apy (TVL-weighted), total_pool_tvl_usd, pools[] each with apy/apyBase/apyReward/apyMean30d/apyPct30D and pool tvlUsd/chain/symbol}, plus provenance/attribution/disclaimer. Verified live 2026-08-07 with slug='ondo-yield-assets' -> HTTP 200, $0.008 charged, Ondo Yield Assets, 11 pools, TVL-weighted avg APY ~3.53%, total pool TVL ~$2.52B.

name: Agentstools Smartmoney Leaderboard
description: Ranked Hyperliquid smart-money leaderboard: the top perp traders ranked by a performance window (day/week/month/allTime) and metric (pnl/roi/vlm), each with wallet address, account value, PnL, ROI, volume and a consistency flag (profitable in every window). Includes a human-readable top-N summary; optional follow=true adds the current open positions of the single top-ranked address.

window.description: Performance window to rank by (default day).

sort.description: Ranking metric within the window (default pnl).

limit.description: Top-N (default 20, max 100).

follow.description: If true, also return the current open perp positions of the single top-ranked address.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/smartmoney/leaderboard?window=<day|week|month|allTime>&sort=<pnl|roi|vlm>&limit=<1-100>[&follow=true] — all query params optional (defaults window=day, sort=pnl, limit=20). No body. x402 v2 on Base USDC, $0.10. Result is inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no polling).
usage.outputShape: window (string echo), sort (string echo), count (int), leaders[] each { address, display_name (nullable), account_value (number USD), window, sort, value (number, = the sort metric), pnl (number USD), roi (number, fraction e.g. 0.0099=0.99%), vlm (number USD volume), consistency (bool: profitable in every window) }, summary[] (human-readable top-N strings), source (string), chain ("Hyperliquid L1 (HyperCore)"), partial (bool), errors[], ts (int Unix SECONDS), disclaimer, attribution
quirks: All params are OPTIONAL — a bare GET returns window=day/sort=pnl/limit=20; but a bare (unpaid) GET already returns a live 402 (payment-required header, empty {} body).
The x402 accepts arrive in the 'payment-required' RESPONSE HEADER (base64-encoded JSON), not the response body (body is {}).
roi is a FRACTION not a percent (e.g. 0.0099953 = 0.9995%); some rows show extreme roi (>1) for small-account/high-turnover wallets — the human 'summary' renders it as a percent.
value mirrors the chosen sort metric (== pnl when sort=pnl); vlm is often 0 for wallets not sorted/traded by volume.
consistency:true means the wallet was profitable across every window (a robustness flag).
Optional follow=true returns the current open perp positions of the single top-ranked address (follow-the-smart-money).
ts is Unix SECONDS (not ms). Data is Hyperliquid public on-chain / stats feed — informational only, not financial advice.
usage.guide: Rank the top traders (smart money) on Hyperliquid in one call. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/smartmoney/leaderboard with optional query params window (day|week|month|allTime, default day), sort (pnl|roi|vlm, default pnl), limit (1-100, default 20), and follow (bool). No body. Pay $0.10 x402 USDC on Base and read the result inline at 200 (synchronous, no polling). Output: leaders[] ranked by the chosen metric, each with address, account_value, pnl, roi (as a fraction), vlm, and a consistency flag, plus a human-readable summary[] and a chain/source/ts envelope. Set follow=true to also pull the top-ranked wallet's current open positions. Public on-chain data — informational only, not financial advice.

symbol.description: Stablecoin ticker (e.g. USDC, USDT, DAI) or a DefiLlama stablecoin id

address.description: Contract address (alternative to symbol)

chain.description: Chain for the address and to prefer for on-chain verification

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/stablecoin/profile with a query param identifying the coin: symbol (ticker like USDC/USDT/DAI, or a DefiLlama stablecoin id), OR address (contract) plus optional chain. No request body. Pays $0.02 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453). Result is returned inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: identity{symbol,name,llama_id,issuer,pegType,collateral_mechanism,mechanism_note}; peg{price,peg_deviation,depeg_status}; supply{circulating_total,per_chain{<chain>:amount,...},chain_count,onchain_verification{available,chain,network,address,onchain_total_supply,onchain_total_supply_raw,defillama_chain_circulating,divergence_flag,relative_diff,attribution},divergence_flag}; contracts[]{chain,network,address}; proof_of_reserve{available,note}; depeg_risk_score; rating; reasons[]{signal,points,detail}; citations[]; disclaimer.

supply.per_chain enumerates circulating amounts across ~150 chains (chain_count 154 on the verified USDC call); values are live DefiLlama figures and change between calls.
onchain_verification independently reads ERC-20 totalSupply via public RPC and cross-checks it against DefiLlama's per-chain circulating, exposing a divergence_flag and relative_diff.
depeg_risk_score (0-100) is a DERIVED, deterministic signal from public data with per-signal reasons — the provider explicitly labels it NOT financial advice, not an audit, and not a depeg guarantee.
proof_of_reserve is a gated PHASE-2 feature: available:false by default until a reserve-attestation feed map is wired.
usage.guide: Get a one-call stablecoin risk profile. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/stablecoin/profile?symbol=USDC (or use address + optional chain instead of symbol). No body. Pays $0.02 USDC via x402 on Base. Returns identity + collateral mechanism, the peg (price, deviation from $1, depeg status), supply (total + per-chain circulating with an independent on-chain totalSupply cross-check and divergence flag), known contract addresses, and a deterministic 0-100 depeg-risk score with rating and per-signal reasons, each figure cited to its source (DefiLlama + public RPC). Verified live 2026-08-07: USDC -> price $0.9997, depeg_status 'stable', circulating ~72.1B across 154 chains, depeg_risk_score 10 (rating 'low').

name: Agentstools Token Meta
description: Resolves an ERC-20 contract to its on-chain metadata — name, symbol, decimals and totalSupply (both raw integer and human-scaled) — read live from contract state by address, across Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon or BNB.

network.description: EVM network to read from (default base)

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/token/meta?token=<0x-ERC20-address>&network=<base|ethereum|arbitrum|optimism|polygon|bnb> (token REQUIRED query param; network optional, default base). No body. x402 v2 on Base USDC, $0.005. Result is inline in the 200 body (synchronous).
usage.outputShape: address (the resolved contract), name (token name), symbol (ticker), decimals (int), total_supply_raw (string, raw integer supply), total_supply (number, decimals-scaled human supply), network (echo), chain (CAIP-2, e.g. eip155:8453), ts (Unix seconds), cached (bool)
quirks: token is REQUIRED and passed as a query param on a GET (no body); network is optional and defaults to base
network enum: base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bnb (multi-chain EVM)
Read live from on-chain contract state; handles bytes32-style name/symbol tokens
EOA / non-contract address -> 404; a contract that is not ERC-20 -> 400
total_supply_raw is the raw integer as a string; total_supply is that value scaled by decimals
usage.guide: Resolve an ERC-20 token's on-chain metadata in one paid call. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/token/meta?token=<0x-contract-address>&network=<base|ethereum|arbitrum|optimism|polygon|bnb> (token required; network defaults to base). No body. Pays $0.005 USDC via x402 on Base (no API key). Synchronous — the 200 body carries {address, name, symbol, decimals, total_supply_raw (string), total_supply (human-scaled number), network, chain, ts, cached}. Verified live 2026-08-07 with the documented USDC-on-Base example -> HTTP 200, $0.005 charged, returned name 'USD Coin', symbol 'USDC', decimals 6. Non-contract -> 404; non-ERC-20 -> 400.

name: Agentstools Transaction Lookup
description: Look up an EVM transaction by hash across Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon or BNB (default Base), returning from/to/value/nonce/gas fields, block info, and receipt fields (status, gas used, logs count).

hash.description: Transaction hash (0x..., 32 bytes). Required query param.

network.description: EVM network to read from (default base).

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/tx?hash=<0x tx hash>&network=<base|ethereum|arbitrum|optimism|polygon|bnb>. Required query param: hash. network optional (default base). No body. x402 v2 on Base USDC (eip155:8453), $0.01. Result is inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: hash, from, to, value_wei (string), value_eth (number), nonce, gas, gas_price, max_fee_per_gas, max_priority_fee_per_gas, block_number, block_hash, transaction_index, input_size, network (echo), chain (CAIP-2 e.g. eip155:8453), ts (unix seconds), cached (bool), status (1 success / 0 fail), gas_used, cumulative_gas_used, effective_gas_price, contract_address (string|null — set on contract-creation tx), logs_count
quirks: hash is REQUIRED and passed as a query param on a GET (no body); omitting it 4xx
network is OPTIONAL and defaults to base; supported enum: base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bnb
Reads confirmed on-chain tx + receipt; the provider notes pending/not-found are handled (a not-yet-mined or unknown hash returns a handled response rather than a hard error)
value_wei is a string (wei) and value_eth a decimal number; status is 1 for success, 0 for revert
Distinct from the sibling POST /tx/signature (EIP-712 signature screening) and POST /tx/raw (raw calldata screening) — this is a read-only tx lookup, not a safety screen
usage.guide: Look up a confirmed EVM transaction by its hash in one keyless paid call. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/tx?hash=<0x... 32-byte tx hash> (required); optionally add &network=<base|ethereum|arbitrum|optimism|polygon|bnb> (default base). No body. x402 v2 on Base USDC (eip155:8453), $0.01, no API key — pay the 402 quote and re-request; the result is inline in the synchronous 200 body. Returns the tx fields (from, to, value_wei/value_eth, nonce, gas/gas_price/max_fee/max_priority_fee), block info (block_number, block_hash, transaction_index), and receipt fields (status 1/0, gas_used, cumulative_gas_used, effective_gas_price, contract_address, logs_count), plus chain (CAIP-2) and ts. Verified live: hash 0x71e6...97d2 on base returned from 0xc358...D3a8 -> to 0x83D5...90d5, block_number 48317438, status 1, gas_used 178458, logs_count 3. For pre-sign safety screening use /tx/raw or /tx/signature instead.

name: Agentstools Token Unlock Calendar
description: Forward-looking token unlock and vesting calendar for one crypto token: the next unlock (date, token amount, USD value, percent of circulating supply), all upcoming cliff and linear unlocks in a forward window, the allocation split across team/investors/ecosystem/community, supply metrics and a deterministic 0-100 supply-overhang score. Sourced from DeFiLlama's public emissions dataset.

ticker.description: Token ticker symbol, e.g. ARB (query param).

slug.description: DeFiLlama emissions slug, e.g. arbitrum (query param). Most reliable resolver.

window_days.description: Forward window for upcoming unlocks (query param), default 365.

include_backtest.description: Include price response to past unlocks (query param), default false.

by_bucket.description: Percent allocation across team, investors, ecosystem, community, treasury, public.

supply_overhang_score.description: Deterministic 0-100 score aggregating upcoming unlocks as a percent of circulating supply weighted by how soon they land.

reason.description: Present when found is false, e.g. 'no emissions/unlock schedule found for <query>'.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/unlock/calendar?ticker=<TICKER>&window_days=<N> — identify the token by one of ticker | name | slug (query params); optional window_days (1-1825, default 365) and include_backtest (bool, default false). No request body, no API key. First call returns HTTP 402 with an x402 challenge in the `payment-required` response HEADER (base64 x402 v2; body is an empty {}); settling it returns HTTP 200 with the result inline (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: JSON. On a resolvable token (per provider docs): {found:true, token{slug,name,symbol,token_id}, price_usd, as_of, window{window_days,horizon}, next_unlock{date_iso,unix,tokens,usd_value,pct_of_circulating,unlock_type,category}, upcoming_returned, supply{max_supply,circulating,pct_unlocked}, allocation{by_bucket{team,investors,ecosystem,...}}, supply_overhang_score (0-100), attribution}. On no match: {found:false, query, reason, attribution, disclaimer}. LIVE PAID RESULT (2026-08-07, ticker=ARB&window_days=365): HTTP 200, $0.02 charged, but found:false with reason 'no emissions/unlock schedule found for ARB' — the ticker resolver did not match ARB at call time; prefer slug=arbitrum or name=Arbitrum for reliable resolution.
quirks: Identify the token by ONE of ticker | name | slug (all query params). LIVE OBSERVATION: ticker=ARB returned found:false ('no emissions/unlock schedule found for ARB') despite being the provider's own documented example — prefer slug=<defillama-slug> (e.g. slug=arbitrum) or name=<protocol> for reliable resolution.
Fixed price $0.02 (amount 20000, USDC 6 decimals on Base eip155:8453); not dynamic.
402 challenge is delivered in the `payment-required` response HEADER (base64 x402 v2), not the body — the 402 body is an empty {}.
Degrades to a partial/not-found answer ({found:false, reason}) rather than erroring when a token can't be resolved or a source block is missing.

Distinct same-host operations, NOT aliases: /unlock/next (single next unlock + emission velocity, $0.008) and /unlock/upcoming (market-wide screener of the biggest unlocks, $0.05). Use this /unlock/calendar route for exhaustive single-token coverage.
Data is derived from DeFiLlama's public emissions dataset; response carries an explicit not-investment-advice disclaimer.
usage.guide: Get a forward-looking supply-shock calendar for one crypto token. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/unlock/calendar with a token identifier query param — prefer slug=<defillama-slug> (e.g. slug=arbitrum) or name=<protocol>; ticker=<SYMBOL> is documented but resolved unreliably live. Optional window_days (1-1825, default 365) and include_backtest (bool). No body, no API key. Pays $0.02 USDC via x402 on Base. Returns the next unlock (date, token amount, USD value, % of circulating), all upcoming cliff/linear unlocks in the window sorted by date, the allocation split (team/investors/ecosystem/community/treasury/public), supply metrics (max/circulating/% unlocked) and a deterministic 0-100 supply-overhang score — all cited to DeFiLlama. Verified live 2026-08-07 (paid 200, $0.02); ticker=ARB returned found:false, so use slug=arbitrum for populated data.

name: Agentstools Next Token Unlock
description: The single next scheduled token unlock for one crypto token (cheapest actionable pre-trade signal): give a ticker, protocol name or DeFiLlama slug and get the nearest upcoming unlock — date, on-schedule token amount, USD value, percent of circulating supply, unlock type/category — plus the token's recent emission velocity over 24h/7d/30d/1y. Data from DeFiLlama, cited.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/unlock/next?ticker=<SYMBOL> (supply ONE of ticker | name | slug as a query param; no body). x402 v2 on Base USDC, $0.008. Result is inline in the 200 body (synchronous).
usage.outputShape: found (bool). When found:true — token {slug, name, symbol}, price_usd (number USD), as_of (ISO date), next_unlock {date_iso, unix (int seconds), tokens (on-schedule token amount), usd_value, pct_of_circulating, unlock_type e.g. cliff/linear, category e.g. insiders}, emission_velocity {emission_24h, emission_7d, emission_30d, emissions_1y}, attribution. When found:false — {found:false, query (echo), reason, attribution, disclaimer} and no unlock fields.
quirks: Supply exactly one identifier as a query param on a GET (ticker OR name OR slug); no request body. ticker is the documented default.

Data is derived from DeFiLlama's public emissions dataset; only tokens with a curated DeFiLlama emissions/vesting schedule resolve. When no schedule is found the call still returns HTTP 200 (and still charges) with {found:false, reason:"no emissions/unlock schedule found for '<query>'"} — so found MUST be checked before reading next_unlock.

Observed at index time: the provider's own documented example ticker=ARB returned found:false ('no emissions/unlock schedule found for ARB') despite a paid HTTP 200 — the endpoint is functioning and well-formed, but ticker resolution to a DeFiLlama slug is data-availability dependent; try the DeFiLlama slug (e.g. slug=arbitrum) or protocol name when a ticker returns found:false.
unix in next_unlock is Unix SECONDS; tokens/usd_value are on-schedule estimates, not guarantees.
Informational only, not investment advice; every figure is attributed to DeFiLlama.
For the full forward calendar of one token use /unlock/calendar; for a market-wide screener of the biggest upcoming unlocks use /unlock/upcoming (separate services).
usage.guide: The cheapest actionable token-unlock signal for a trading agent: just the single next scheduled unlock for one crypto token, without the full calendar. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/unlock/next with exactly one query param — ticker (e.g. ARB), name (e.g. Arbitrum) or slug (DeFiLlama emissions slug, e.g. arbitrum); no body. x402 v2 on Base USDC, $0.008; no API key. Synchronous — the 200 body carries {found, token, price_usd, as_of, next_unlock {date_iso, unix, tokens, usd_value, pct_of_circulating, unlock_type, category}, emission_velocity {emission_24h, emission_7d, emission_30d, emissions_1y}, attribution}. ALWAYS check found first: only tokens with a DeFiLlama emissions schedule resolve, and an unresolved query returns a paid HTTP 200 with {found:false, reason}. Data from DeFiLlama, cited; informational, not investment advice. Verified 2026-08-07 with ticker=ARB -> HTTP 200 (found:false, DeFiLlama slug did not resolve for the ARB ticker at call time), $0.008 charged.

name: Agentstools Upcoming Unlocks
description: Market-wide screener of the biggest upcoming token unlocks across crypto: selects the most active emitters, extracts each one's nearest upcoming unlock inside a forward window, prices it, and returns the set ranked by USD value or percent of circulating supply. Sourced from DeFiLlama.

window_days.description: Forward window in days (query param); default 90.

rank_by.description: Rank the returned unlocks by unlock USD value or by percent of circulating supply (query param); default usd_value.

limit.description: Max rows to return (query param); default 25.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/unlock/upcoming with OPTIONAL query params: window_days (integer 1-1825, default 90), rank_by ('usd_value'|'pct_float', default usd_value), limit (integer 1-25, default 25). No request body, no API key. First call returns HTTP 402 with an x402 v2 challenge (USDC on Base eip155:8453) delivered in the payment-required response HEADER (402 body is {}); settling it and re-requesting returns HTTP 200 with the ranked screen inline (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: JSON: found (bool), as_of (ISO date), window {window_days, horizon (ISO)}, rank_by, results_returned (2), results[] each {slug, name, symbol, token_id, price_usd, next_unlock {date_iso, unix, tokens, usd_value, pct_of_circulating, unlock_type ('cliff'|'linear'), category, description}}, scanned (12), truncated (bool), partial (bool), coverage_note, attribution (DeFiLlama), disclaimer. Observed on a verified 200: results_returned 2 — Canton (CC) linear unlock 2026-08-08 usd_value ~$10.03M, EigenCloud (EIGEN) cliff 2026-08-31 usd_value ~$3.43M; scanned 12, truncated true.
quirks: All three params (window_days, rank_by, limit) are QUERY params and OPTIONAL — omit everything for a default 90-day usd_value screen of up to 25 rows.
Fixed price $0.05 (amount 50000, USDC 6 decimals on Base); not dynamic.
402 challenge is delivered in the base64 `payment-required` response HEADER (x402 v2), not the body — the 402 body is an empty {}.

BOUNDED market-wide screen: only the top ~12 most active emitters (by projected 1-year emission) are fanned out and ranked; the response is marked truncated:true with a coverage_note. For exhaustive coverage of ONE token use the sibling /unlock/calendar (full calendar) or /unlock/next (single next unlock) routes.
Data is a DERIVED aggregate over DeFiLlama's public emissions dataset + coins.llama.fi prices; response carries an explicit not-investment-advice disclaimer.
Distinct op from same-host /unlock/next (one token, next unlock) and /unlock/calendar (one token, full forward calendar) — not aliases.
usage.guide: Screen the crypto market for the biggest upcoming token unlocks in one paid call. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/unlock/upcoming?rank_by=usd_value&window_days=90 (all params optional: rank_by 'usd_value'|'pct_float' default usd_value, window_days 1-1825 default 90, limit 1-25 default 25). No body, no API key. Pay $0.05 USDC via x402 on Base and re-request; the result is inline in the synchronous 200 body. Returns the nearest upcoming unlock for each of the most active emitters ranked by USD value or share of float — each row carries protocol slug/name/symbol, price, and next_unlock {date, tokens, usd_value, pct_of_circulating, unlock_type, category}. It is a BOUNDED screen (top ~12 emitters, truncated:true) — for exhaustive per-token coverage use /unlock/calendar with a ticker. Sourced from DeFiLlama; informational, not investment advice. Verified live 2026-08-07: rank_by=usd_value&window_days=90 → HTTP 200, $0.05 charged, results_returned 2 (Canton ~$10.03M linear 2026-08-08, EigenCloud ~$3.43M cliff 2026-08-31), scanned 12.

name: Agentstools Wallet Balances
description: Native-coin balance plus ERC-20 token balances (raw + human-scaled) for any EVM address on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon or BNB, with optional best-effort USD valuation on Base.

address.description: Wallet address (0x..). Required.

network.description: EVM network to read from (default base).

tokens.description: Base: token symbols or 0x addresses (default common set, max 25). Other networks: explicit 0x addresses only. Repeated query param (?tokens=USDC&tokens=WETH).

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/wallet/balances?address=<0x..> with OPTIONAL query params: network (base|ethereum|arbitrum|optimism|polygon|bnb, default base), tokens (repeated query param, e.g. &tokens=USDC&tokens=WETH — symbols or 0x addresses on Base, explicit 0x addresses on other networks), usd (boolean, Base-only USD valuation). No request body. Pays $0.005 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453). Result is inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: address (echo), native {symbol, balance_raw (raw integer string), balance (human number)}, tokens[] each {token (symbol), address (0x contract), decimals (int), balance_raw (raw integer string), balance (human number)}, network (string), chain (CAIP-2, e.g. eip155:8453), ts (Unix seconds). With usd=true, best-effort USD values are added (Base only).
quirks: address is REQUIRED and passed as a query param on a GET (no body); omitting it 4xx
tokens is an ARRAY query param — repeat it: ?tokens=USDC&tokens=WETH (max 25 tokens)

On Base you may pass token SYMBOLS (USDC, WETH) or 0x addresses, and get a default common set if tokens is omitted; on ethereum/arbitrum/optimism/polygon/bnb you must pass EXPLICIT 0x token addresses (symbol map and USD valuation are Base-only)
usd=true adds best-effort USD values but only on Base (via the provider's on-chain price feed)
balance_raw is a raw integer STRING scaled by the token's decimals; balance is the human-readable number
ts is Unix SECONDS; chain is CAIP-2 (eip155:8453 = Base)
402 payment-required carries the x402 accepts in the payment-required HEADER (base64); the 402 body is empty
usage.guide: Get a portfolio snapshot for any EVM address in one paid call. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/wallet/balances?address=<0x..> (optionally &network=<base|ethereum|arbitrum|optimism|polygon|bnb>, repeated &tokens=<SYMBOL_or_0x>, &usd=true). No body. Pays $0.005 USDC via x402 on Base. Returns native-coin balance plus each requested ERC-20 balance as both a raw integer string and a human-scaled number, with token contract address and decimals. On Base you can use token symbols and get optional USD values; on other EVM networks pass explicit 0x token addresses. Verified live: address 0x2d3af9...C423 on base returned native ETH 0, USDC 0.228 (raw 228000, 6 decimals), WETH 0 (18 decimals), chain eip155:8453.

name: Agentstools Bridge Exploits
description: Cross-chain bridge hack track record: for one bridge, its exploit history (incident count, total USD lost, funds returned, worst technique); with no bridge, a ranked leaderboard of every bridge hack by USD lost — computed from DefiLlama's hack dataset, normalized by the provider.

bridge.description: Bridge name, slug or alias (e.g. Stargate, Across, Wormhole, Arbitrum, CCTP). Resolved case-insensitively to the covered set. Omit for a ranked leaderboard of all bridge hacks by USD lost.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/bridge/exploits with an OPTIONAL query param: bridge (string — name, slug or alias, case-insensitive; e.g. Stargate, Across, Wormhole, Arbitrum, CCTP). Omit bridge to get a ranked leaderboard of every bridge hack by USD lost. No request body. Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453). Result returned inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: For a single bridge: {bridge (display name), key (slug), incidents (count), total_lost_usd, total_returned_usd, worst_technique, history:[{name, date (unix), amount_usd, returned_usd, technique, classification, chains[], bridge_hack (bool), target_type}], sources:[string], ts (unix), attribution}. With no bridge param: a ranked leaderboard of every bridge hack by USD lost.
quirks: The bridge query param is OPTIONAL: pass a bridge (name/slug/alias, case-insensitive) for that bridge's track record, or omit it for a ranked leaderboard of all bridge hacks by USD lost.
Deterministic (no LLM): computed from DefiLlama's keyless open hack dataset, joined and normalized by the provider — a track record of past incidents, not a live/predictive safety guarantee.
Historical amounts are point-in-time USD at the time of each incident; total_returned_usd tracks funds recovered.
usage.guide: Get a cross-chain bridge's hack track record in one paid call. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/bridge/exploits?bridge=wormhole (bridge query param optional — name/slug/alias, case-insensitive; omit for a ranked leaderboard of every bridge hack by USD lost). Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base. Returns incident count, total USD lost, funds returned, worst technique and a per-incident history (date, amount, technique, classification, chains) sourced from DefiLlama's hack dataset. Answers 'how safe is bridge X' or 'which bridges have lost the most to hacks'. Verified live: bridge=wormhole returned 1 incident, $326M lost / $326M returned, worst technique 'Signature Exploit' (Portal, 2022, Solana).

name: Agentstools Bridge Route
description: Corridor safety verdict for a cross-chain hop — given a source chain, destination chain and optional asset/amount, returns every bridge covering that corridor with a deterministic risk score and safe/caution/avoid tier, sorted safe-first, plus the single recommended bridge and the reasons.

src.description: Source chain (e.g. ethereum, arbitrum, base, polygon, bsc).

dst.description: Destination chain (e.g. arbitrum, optimism, base, solana).

asset.description: Asset ticker to move (e.g. USDC, ETH, WBTC). Optional; echoed.

amount.description: Amount to move, for context. Optional; echoed.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/bridge/route?src=<chain>&dst=<chain>&asset=<TICKER>&amount=<number> — src and dst are REQUIRED query params; asset and amount are OPTIONAL (echoed). No request body. x402 v2 on Base USDC (eip155:8453), $0.05. Result is inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: corridor.{src, dst, asset, amount}, bridge_count (int), recommended.{bridge, key, risk_score (int), tier ("safe"|"caution"|"avoid")}, bridges[] (sorted safe->avoid) each with {bridge, key, risk_score, tier, trust_model, kind, tvl_usd (number|null), exploit_incidents (int), reasons[] (strings)}, partial (bool), errors[], note (string), ts (unix seconds), attribution (string).
quirks: src and dst are passed as query params on a GET — there is no request body. asset/amount are optional and only echoed back into `corridor`, they do not change the corridor's bridge set.
Bridges are sorted safe-first (ascending risk_score); `recommended` is the top (lowest-risk) bridge for the corridor.

risk_score/tier are the provider's OWN deterministic fusion (bridge exploit history from DefiLlama /hacks, TVL/coverage from DefiLlama /protocols, canonical-L2 trust-model risks from L2Beat), not resale of a dashboard — the note states 'intelligence, not financial advice'.
tvl_usd can be null for some bridges (e.g. Circle CCTP) — handle nulls in the bridges[] list.
The 402 outputSchema also permits method HEAD/DELETE, but GET is the documented and verified method.

Verified live 2026-08-07: src=ethereum&dst=arbitrum&asset=USDC -> HTTP 200, $0.05 charged, bridge_count 10, recommended Arbitrum Bridge (risk_score 14, tier safe), full list scored safe->avoid down to Stargate/LayerZero (46, caution).
usage.guide: Pick the safest bridge for a cross-chain hop in one paid call. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/bridge/route?src=<chain>&dst=<chain> (src and dst required; add &asset=<TICKER> and &amount=<number> for context — both optional and echoed). No body. Pays $0.05 USDC via x402 on Base. Returns every bridge covering the corridor with a deterministic risk_score and safe/caution/avoid tier (sorted safe-first), plus each bridge's trust_model, kind, tvl_usd, exploit_incidents and human-readable reasons, and a single `recommended` bridge. Scores fuse DefiLlama hacks + TVL and L2Beat trust-model risk — the provider's own verdict, not financial advice. Verified live: ethereum->arbitrum USDC -> 10 bridges, recommended Arbitrum Bridge (risk_score 14, safe).

name: Agentstools Bridge Screen
description: Deterministic cross-chain bridge safety screen — pass a bridge name/slug/alias (Stargate, Across, Wormhole, Arbitrum, CCTP, ...) and get a 0-100 risk score plus a safe/caution/avoid verdict fusing trust model, TVL depth, exploit history and governance/upgrade risk, with per-component weights and plain-language reasons.

bridge.description: Bridge name, slug or alias (e.g. Stargate, Across, Wormhole, Arbitrum, CCTP). Resolved case-insensitively to the covered set.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/bridge/screen?bridge=<NAME> (x402 payment, $0.05 USDC on Base; 'bridge' is a REQUIRED query parameter). Result returned inline in the 200 JSON body — no polling.
usage.outputShape: body.risk_score (0-100, higher = riskier), body.tier ('safe'|'caution'|'avoid'), body.trust_model, body.validation_type, body.tvl_usd, body.exploit_summary{incidents,total_lost_usd,worst_incident}, body.components{trust,exploit,tvl,governance} + body.weights, body.reasons[] (plain-language), body.supported_chains[], body.l2beat (canonical-L2 risk rows or null), body.sources[], body.partial, body.note, body.attribution, body.ts
quirks: 'bridge' is a REQUIRED query parameter (not path or body); an unknown bridge returns 404, bad input 400, upstream failure 502.
Score is fully deterministic — a formula in code (weighted trust/exploit/tvl/governance), NO model or LLM; every component, weight and reason is returned so it's reproducible.
For canonical L2 bridges (Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, zkSync Era, Linea, Polygon, Starknet) body.l2beat is populated with L2Beat risk rows; otherwise null.
A failing enrichment degrades to body.partial=true rather than erroring; check it before trusting a low score.
Sources are open + keyless (DefiLlama hacks/protocols, L2Beat MIT) and cited per response; 'Intelligence, not financial advice.'
usage.guide: Call GET https://api.agentstools.dev/bridge/screen with a REQUIRED 'bridge' query parameter (name/slug/alias, e.g. ?bridge=stargate or ?bridge=across). Pay the x402 quote ($0.05 USDC on Base, asset USDC 0x8335...2913, payTo 0xF22e...F493). The verdict comes back synchronously in the top-level JSON body: read risk_score (0-100, higher = riskier), tier ('safe'/'caution'/'avoid'), and reasons[] for the human-readable rationale; use components/weights to see how trust model, exploit history, TVL depth and governance risk were fused. Use before routing funds through a bridge. Unknown bridge → 404; check partial=true for degraded enrichment. Data is DefiLlama/L2Beat-sourced and live.

name: Agentstools Bridge TVL
description: Total value locked and per-chain liquidity concentration for a cross-chain bridge (from DefiLlama): overall TVL, the breakdown across chains, and the largest single chain's share — a liquidity-depth and concentration signal for routing decisions.

bridge.description: Bridge name, slug or alias (e.g. Stargate, Across, Wormhole, Arbitrum, CCTP). Resolved case-insensitively to the covered set.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/bridge/tvl?bridge=<BRIDGE> (required query param: bridge). No body. x402 v2 on Base USDC, $0.01. Result is inline in the 200 body (synchronous).
usage.outputShape: bridge (string, display name), key (string, resolved slug), tvl_usd (number, total USD TVL), per_chain_tvl_usd (object map of chain name -> USD TVL), top_chain_concentration (number 0-1, largest single chain's share of TVL; 1.0 = all on one chain), sources (string[], e.g. ["defillama:across"]), partial (bool), errors (string[]), note (string, explains top_chain_concentration), ts (int, Unix SECONDS), attribution (string, data-source provenance)
quirks: bridge is REQUIRED and passed as a query param on a GET (no body); omitting it returns an empty {} 402/4xx
bridge accepts a name, slug or alias (Stargate, Across, Wormhole, Arbitrum, CCTP, ...), resolved case-insensitively
top_chain_concentration is the largest single chain's share of TVL (1.0 = all liquidity concentrated on one chain)
ts is Unix SECONDS (not milliseconds)
Data is fused from DefiLlama /protocols; partial:true + errors[] signal a degraded/incomplete read
usage.guide: Total value locked and per-chain liquidity concentration for a cross-chain bridge, from DefiLlama. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/bridge/tvl?bridge=<BRIDGE> (required query param: bridge — a bridge name, slug or alias such as across, stargate, wormhole, arbitrum, cctp). No body. x402 v2 on Base USDC, $0.01. Synchronous — the 200 body carries {bridge, key, tvl_usd, per_chain_tvl_usd, top_chain_concentration, sources, partial, errors, note, ts, attribution}. top_chain_concentration (0-1) flags how much of the TVL sits on a single chain.

name: Agentstools Perpetual Basis
description: Perpetual basis for a crypto asset — the mark-versus-oracle premium in basis points on venues that publish a native mark price (Hyperliquid), with a naive annualized carry proxy, computed from decentralized-protocol public state as a froth and leverage-cost signal.

symbol.description: Base asset ticker (BTC, ETH, SOL). A quote suffix such as BTC-USD or BTC-PERP is accepted and normalized server-side.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/derivs/basis?symbol=<TICKER> — required query param: symbol (base asset ticker; a quote suffix like SOL-USD or BTC-PERP is normalized server-side). No request body. Pays $0.008 USDC via x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453). Result is returned inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: symbol (string echo), venues[] each {venue, name, mark (number), oracle (number), premium (number, venue-native), basis_bps (number, (mark-oracle)/oracle in bps), annualized_carry_pct (number, naive hourly-premium annualization)}, sources[] (venue/name/symbol/chain/attribution), note (string, formula), partial (boolean), errors[] (array), ts (unix seconds), attribution (string).
quirks: Required query param `symbol` on a GET; there is no request body. A quote suffix (SOL-USD, BTC-PERP) is accepted and normalized server-side.
Only venues that publish a NATIVE mark price contribute a basis — Hyperliquid does; dYdX v4 exposes an oracle only, so it appears in sources[] but not venues[].

basis_bps = (mark - oracle) / oracle in basis points; annualized_carry_pct naively annualizes the instantaneous premium as an hourly carry — a proxy, not a realized return (can be large in magnitude, e.g. -463% observed).
Sources are decentralized-protocol public read-only state (not a resold centralized-exchange feed). Bad input is a 400; an asset with no mark-publishing venue is a 404; never a 500.
Verified live: symbol=SOL returned hyperliquid mark 73.716, oracle 73.755, basis_bps -5.2878, annualized_carry_pct -463.2093, partial false.
usage.guide: Get the perpetual basis (froth / leverage-cost signal) for a crypto asset in one paid call. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/derivs/basis?symbol=<TICKER> (e.g. SOL, BTC, ETH; a quote suffix like SOL-USD is normalized). No body. Pays $0.008 USDC via x402 on Base. Returns, per mark-publishing venue (Hyperliquid), the mark and oracle prices, the venue-native premium, the basis in basis points ((mark-oracle)/oracle), and a naive annualized carry proxy — plus source attribution. A persistently positive basis means longs are paying up (froth); negative means the perp trades below spot. Intelligence, not trading advice. Verified live: SOL returned basis_bps -5.29, annualized_carry_pct -463.2.

name: Agentstools Derivs Funding
description: Perpetual-swap funding rates for a crypto asset fused across decentralized venues (Hyperliquid, dYdX v4): each venue's current funding rate, interval and annualized APR, plus an open-interest-weighted aggregate funding rate, aggregate APR, cross-venue spread in basis points and dispersion — one normalized call instead of polling each protocol and reconciling funding intervals.

symbol.description: Base asset ticker (BTC, ETH, SOL). A quote suffix such as BTC-USD or BTC-PERP is accepted and normalized server-side.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/derivs/funding?symbol=<TICKER> (required query param: symbol). No body. x402 v2 on Base USDC, $0.01. Result is inline in the 200 body (synchronous).
usage.outputShape: symbol (string echo), venues[] (per-venue {venue, name, funding_rate, funding_interval_hours, funding_hourly, apr, oi_usd}), aggregate {oi_weighted_funding_hourly, apr, spread_bps, spread_apr, dispersion, weighting, venue_count}, sources[] (per-venue attribution {venue, name, symbol, chain, attribution}), partial (bool), errors[] (per-venue failures when partial), ts (int, Unix SECONDS), attribution (string)
quirks: symbol is REQUIRED and passed as a query param on a GET (no body); a bad symbol is a 400, an unlisted symbol is a 404, total upstream failure is a 502 (never a 500)
Fusion base is DECENTRALIZED venues only — Hyperliquid (public Info API) and dYdX v4 (public Indexer); centralized-exchange feeds (Binance/Bybit/OKX/Coinalyze) are deliberately excluded
Pass a base ticker (BTC, ETH, SOL); a quote suffix like BTC-USD or BTC-PERP is normalized server-side
funding_rate is the raw per-interval rate; funding_hourly is interval-normalized; apr is annualized. aggregate.spread_bps is the cross-venue funding spread (a funding-arb/disagreement signal)
aggregate funding is OPEN-INTEREST-weighted so a deep venue counts more than a thin one
A single venue failing sets partial:true and reports it under errors[]; ts is Unix SECONDS not milliseconds
Market-structure intelligence, not trading advice
usage.guide: Perpetual-swap funding rates for a crypto asset fused across decentralized perp venues (Hyperliquid, dYdX v4). GET https://api.agentstools.dev/derivs/funding?symbol=<TICKER> (required query param: symbol; e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL — a quote suffix like BTC-USD is normalized server-side). No body. x402 v2 on Base USDC, $0.01. Synchronous — the 200 body carries {symbol, venues[], aggregate{oi_weighted_funding_hourly, apr, spread_bps, spread_apr, dispersion, venue_count}, sources[], partial, errors[], ts, attribution}. Use aggregate.spread_bps to spot cross-venue funding-arb; each venue reports raw funding_rate, interval-normalized funding_hourly and annualized apr.

name: Agentstools Derivs Open Interest
description: Aggregate perpetual-swap open interest for a crypto asset fused across decentralized venues (Hyperliquid, dYdX v4): per-venue open interest in coins and USD notional (via each venue's mark or oracle price), the total aggregate USD open interest, and each venue's share — one normalized call across protocols.

symbol.description: Base asset ticker (BTC, ETH, SOL). A quote suffix such as BTC-USD or BTC-PERP is accepted and normalized server-side.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/derivs/oi?symbol=<TICKER> (required query param: symbol, e.g. ETH; a quote suffix like BTC-USD is normalized server-side). No request body. x402 v2 on Base USDC, $0.01. Result is inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: symbol (echo); venues[].{venue (hyperliquid|dydx), name, oi_coins (number), oi_usd (number, USD notional), mark (number|null), oracle (number)}; aggregate.{total_oi_usd (number), venue_shares{<venue>:fraction 0..1}, venue_count (int)}; sources[].{venue, name, symbol, chain, attribution}; partial (bool); errors[]; ts (Unix SECONDS); attribution (string).
quirks: symbol is REQUIRED and passed as a query param on a GET (no body); a quote suffix (BTC-USD, BTC-PERP) is accepted and normalized server-side.
Fusion base is DECENTRALIZED perp state only — Hyperliquid (public Info API / HyperCore) + dYdX v4 (public Indexer). Centralized-exchange feeds (Binance/Bybit/OKX/Coinalyze) are explicitly excluded.
USD open interest = oi_coins x the venue's mark price where available, otherwise its oracle price; dYdX v4 exposes an oracle only (mark can be null), so its oi_usd uses oracle.
aggregate.venue_shares are fractions summing to ~1 (e.g. hyperliquid 0.9939, dydx 0.0061); venue_count is the number of contributing venues.
ts is Unix SECONDS (not milliseconds). partial=true with an errors[] entry when a single venue fails; only a total upstream failure is a 502, an unlisted symbol a 404, bad input a 400 (never a 500).

Verified live (symbol=ETH): hyperliquid oi_usd 1,545,720,306.82 (807,535.738 coins, mark 1914.12), dydx oi_usd 9,490,563.66 (oracle 1914.44, mark null), total_oi_usd 1,555,210,870.48, shares hyperliquid 0.9939 / dydx 0.0061, venue_count 2, partial false.
usage.guide: Get aggregate perpetual open interest for a crypto asset fused across decentralized venues (Hyperliquid + dYdX v4). GET https://api.agentstools.dev/derivs/oi?symbol=<TICKER> (required query param symbol, e.g. ETH; a quote suffix like BTC-USD is normalized server-side). No body. Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base. Synchronous — the 200 body carries venues[] (per venue: oi_coins, oi_usd notional, mark, oracle), aggregate {total_oi_usd, venue_shares, venue_count}, sources[] with per-venue attribution, partial/errors, and ts (Unix seconds). USD OI uses the venue mark price when present else its oracle. Decentralized-protocol state only (Hyperliquid Info API + dYdX v4 Indexer); centralized-exchange feeds are excluded. Market-structure intelligence, not trading advice. Verified live: ETH -> total OI ~$1.555B, Hyperliquid ~99.4% share, dYdX ~0.6%.

symbol.description: Base asset ticker (BTC, ETH, SOL). A quote suffix such as BTC-USD or BTC-PERP is accepted and normalized server-side.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/derivs/positioning?symbol=<TICKER> (required query param: symbol, e.g. BTC/ETH/SOL; a BTC-USD or BTC-PERP suffix is accepted and normalized). quirks: symbol is REQUIRED and passed as a query param on a GET (no body); omitting it 4xx
Only DECENTRALIZED perp state is used (Hyperliquid HyperCore + dYdX v4 Indexer); centralized-exchange feeds (Binance/Bybit/OKX/Coinalyze) are explicitly excluded from the base
score is a deterministic 0-100 blend of funding intensity, basis extremity and cross-venue spread — formula in code, NO LLM; intelligence, not trading advice
quote suffixes (BTC-USD, BTC-PERP) are accepted and normalized server-side to the base ticker
ts is Unix SECONDS (not milliseconds)
partial:true and a populated errors[] signal that one venue failed and the read is degraded; venue_count reflects how many venues contributed
usage.guide: Get a one-call positioning/squeeze read for a single crypto perpetual. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/derivs/positioning?symbol=BTC (required query param: symbol; ticker like BTC/ETH/SOL, a BTC-USD or BTC-PERP suffix is normalized). No body. Pays $0.03 USDC via x402 on Base — no API key. Synchronous: the 200 body carries a deterministic 0-100 squeeze/positioning score with a verdict and crowding direction, plus the underlying signals (aggregate funding + APR, mark-vs-oracle basis, cross-venue funding spread, a Hyperliquid funding-flip trend), 0-1 component sub-scores (funding/basis/spread), aggregate open interest with per-venue shares, and source attribution. Fused from decentralized-protocol state only (Hyperliquid, dYdX v4); centralized-exchange feeds are excluded. name: Agentstools Farcaster Graph
description: Farcaster social-graph slice for a fid or username: the following list with a count, the follower floor with a count, and a sample of mutual connections (counts for large accounts are a floor with a capped flag), sourced from the public Farcaster protocol graph for reputation and network-analysis agents.

username.description: Farcaster username (fname or ENS), without the at-sign. Provide either username or fid.

fid.description: Farcaster ID (FID), a positive integer. Provide either fid or username.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/farcaster/graph with one identity query param — ?username=<fname/ENS, no @> OR ?fid=<positive integer>. No request body, no API key. Pays a fixed $0.01 USDC via x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453, USDC 0x8335...2913, payTo 0xF22e...F493). Synchronous — the JSON result is inline in the 200 body. The 402 challenge (accepts + bazaar input/output schema) is delivered base64-encoded in the 'payment-required' response HEADER; the 402 body is nearly empty.
usage.outputShape: found (bool); fid (int); following{ count (int), capped (bool), sample[] of fids }; followers_floor{ count (int), capped (bool), sample[] of fids }; mutual_sample{ count (int), sample[] of fids }; attribution[] (source strings). Verified live for username=dwr: found=true, fid=3, following.count=1442 (capped=false), followers_floor.count=10000 (capped=true), mutual_sample.count=662; attribution = Farcaster protocol (MIT public graph) + Snapchain public hub (hub.pinata.cloud) + fname registry (fnames.farcaster.xyz).
quirks: Identity is a query param: pass either ?username=<fname/ENS without @> or ?fid=<int>. Both are individually optional in the schema (required=[]), but you must supply one to identify an account.

Follower counts for large accounts are a FLOOR, not exact: followers_floor.capped=true means the true count exceeds the returned floor (observed 10000 with capped=true for dwr). following.capped can be false when the full set fits.
sample[] arrays are a small illustrative subset of fids, not the complete edge list — use them for spot-checks/graph seeds, not a full crawl.
The x402 402 challenge is in the base64-encoded 'payment-required' response HEADER (x402 v2); a naive body-only accepts parser sees nothing.
Public Farcaster protocol data only (Snapchain hub + fname registry) — not financial advice, no auth/API key.
usage.guide: Get a Farcaster social-graph slice for an account. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/farcaster/graph with ONE identity query param — ?username=<fname/ENS, no @> (e.g. ?username=dwr) or ?fid=<positive integer>. No body, no API key. Pays a fixed $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base. Returns JSON synchronously: found, fid, following{count,capped,sample[]}, followers_floor{count,capped,sample[]}, mutual_sample{count,sample[]}, and attribution[]. Counts for large accounts are a FLOOR with capped=true (true count is higher); sample[] arrays are illustrative fid subsets, not full edge lists. Use for reputation scoring and network analysis. Data is the public Farcaster protocol graph. Verified live: dwr (fid 3) → 1442 following, 10000+ followers (capped), 662 mutuals.

name: Agentstools Farcaster Reputation
description: Deterministic 0-100 Farcaster social-reputation score for a fid, username or Ethereum address, combining account age, verified wallets, primary address, username/profile presence, follower floor and cast activity into a score, band and per-dimension reasons for anti-sybil and wallet-provenance checks.

address.description: Ethereum address to score via its linked FID

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/farcaster/reputation with ONE of the OPTIONAL query params: fid (positive integer), username (fname without @), or address (Ethereum address, mapped to its FID). No request body. Pays $0.008 USDC via x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453), keyless. Result is inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: found (bool), fid (int), username (string), resolved_via ("fid"|"username"|"address"), reputation {score (0-100 int), band ("high"|...), dimensions {identity, wallet, tenure, reach, activity — each with tiers/flags}, reasons (string[] of fired signals), disclaimer}, features (flat feature map: has_username, has_display_name, has_bio, has_pfp, has_verified_address, has_primary_address, account_age_days, followers_floor, casts_floor), followers_capped (bool), attribution (string[] sources)
quirks: Supply exactly one of fid / username / address as a query param on a GET (no body); an address is first mapped to its FID before scoring
Partial on facet failure — never returns a 500; an unresolvable identity returns found=false rather than an error
Follower and cast counts are floored/capped (followers_capped:true when reach exceeds the top tier), so features report tier floors (e.g. followers_floor 10000) not exact counts
Score is additive/deterministic over public Farcaster protocol signals; reasons[] audit which dimensions fired
Reputation indicators derived from public data only — NOT a guarantee of trustworthiness; a high score reduces but does not eliminate sybil/impersonation risk
Sourced from the Farcaster protocol, a public Snapchain hub (hub.pinata.cloud) and the fname registry (fnames.farcaster.xyz)
usage.guide: Score a Farcaster identity's social reputation in one keyless paid call — for anti-sybil, airdrop-eligibility and wallet-provenance checks. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/farcaster/reputation?username=<fname> (or ?fid=<int>, or ?address=<0x...>). No body. Pays $0.008 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453). Returns {found, fid, username, resolved_via, reputation:{score 0-100, band, dimensions, reasons[], disclaimer}, features, followers_capped, attribution[]}. Verified live: username=dwr resolved to fid 3, score 100 band 'high' with 9 fired reasons (registered username, display name/bio/pfp, verified + primary wallet, 1y+ tenure, 1000+ followers, active caster).

name: Agentstools Farcaster Resolve
description: Bidirectional Farcaster identity/wallet resolver: give an Ethereum address to get the FID that owns it (custody address resolves keyless), or give a fid/username to get the canonical identity (fid, username, custody address, and verified wallets).

fid.description: Farcaster ID (FID), a positive integer. Forward direction — resolve to canonical identity.

username.description: Farcaster username (fname or ENS), without the at-sign. Forward direction.

address.description: Ethereum address (0x + 40 hex) to reverse to a FID. A custody address resolves keyless; a merely-verified address requires the optional runtime enrichment (reports available=false when unconfigured).

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/farcaster/resolve with exactly one query param: address=<0x…> (reverse) OR fid=<int> OR username=<fname>. No body. x402 v2 on Base USDC, $0.005. Result is inline in the 200 body (synchronous).
usage.outputShape: found (bool), fid (int), username (string), display_name (string), custody_address (0x), primary_eth_address (0x), verified_addresses[] ({address, protocol: ethereum|solana}), query ({type: address|fid|username, value}), match (e.g. "custody"), verified_reverse ({available: bool, fid: int|null} — the optional verified-address→FID enrichment), attribution[] (data-source credits). An unknown/no-match input returns found=false; never a 500.
quirks: Supply exactly ONE of address / fid / username as a query param on a GET (no body).

Reverse (address→FID): a CUSTODY address resolves keyless; a merely-VERIFIED address is gated behind an optional runtime enrichment and returns verified_reverse.available=false when that enrichment is not configured (as observed on this probe).
Forward (fid or username): returns the canonical identity block (fid, username, display_name, custody_address, verified_addresses).
Partial results on facet failure (never a 500); no match returns found=false.
Public Farcaster protocol data only (sourced from Snapchain public hub + fname registry).
Distinct from sibling ops /farcaster/profile (full fused profile), /farcaster/verifications (identity→wallets), /farcaster/reputation (score), and /farcaster/graph (follow graph).
usage.guide: Bidirectional Farcaster identity/wallet resolver. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/farcaster/resolve with exactly one query param: address=<0x…> to reverse a wallet to its FID (custody addresses resolve keyless; verified-address reversal needs an optional enrichment and honestly reports available=false when off), or fid=<int> / username=<fname> to get the canonical identity (fid, username, display name, custody address, verified wallets across Ethereum and Solana). No body. x402 v2 on Base USDC, $0.005. Synchronous — the 200 body carries {found, fid, username, display_name, custody_address, primary_eth_address, verified_addresses[], query, match, verified_reverse, attribution[]}. Example: address=0x6b0bda3f2ffed5efc83fa8c024acff1dd45793f1 resolves to fid 3 (dwr) via custody match. Use for wallet↔social identity reconciliation, provenance, and anti-sybil checks.

name: Agentstools Governance Space
description: Configuration and context of a Snapshot DAO space so a governance agent knows the voting RULES before reasoning about proposals: display name and about text, network and governance token symbol, a compact strategies summary (how voting power is computed), admin/moderator addresses, voting config (delay, period, quorum, type), total proposal and follower counts, and a bucketed count of active/pending/closed proposals. Sourced from Snapshot Hub.

space.description: Snapshot space-id (e.g. uniswapgovernance.eth) or a known protocol alias (e.g. uniswap). Query param. Required.

network.description: EVM chain id as a string (e.g. '1' for Ethereum mainnet).

symbol.description: Governance token symbol (e.g. 'UNI').

strategies_summary.description: Compact summary of the voting-power strategies.

delay.description: Voting delay in seconds, or null.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/governance/space?space=<space-id> — space (Snapshot space-id like uniswapgovernance.eth or a known protocol alias like uniswap) is a REQUIRED query param. No request body, no API key. First call returns HTTP 402 with an x402 challenge in the `payment-required` response HEADER (base64 x402 v2; the 402 body is an empty {}); settling it returns HTTP 200 with the space config inline (synchronous, no poll). A missing/invalid space returns 422, an upstream Snapshot failure 502.
usage.outputShape: JSON: {space:{id, name, about, network(chain-id str), symbol, strategies_summary[], admins[], moderators[], voting:{delay(int|null), period(int sec), quorum(number), type(str|null)}, proposals_count(int), followers_count(int), counts:{active(int), pending(int), closed(int)}}, attribution:[...], disclaimer}. LIVE PAID RESULT (2026-08-07, space=uniswapgovernance.eth): HTTP 200, $0.008 charged, name 'Uniswap', network '1', symbol 'UNI', strategies_summary ['uni'], admins ['0x0459…22255'], voting.period 432000, voting.quorum 10000000, proposals_count 197, followers_count 125276, counts {active:0, pending:0, closed:197}; attribution 'Governance data from Snapshot Hub'.
quirks: space (Snapshot space-id, e.g. uniswapgovernance.eth, or a curated protocol alias, e.g. uniswap) is the only query param and is REQUIRED.
Fixed price $0.008 (amount 8000, USDC 6 decimals on Base eip155:8453); not dynamic.
402 challenge is delivered in the `payment-required` response HEADER (base64 x402 v2), not the body — the 402 body is an empty {}.
active and pending are exact bounded counts; closed is derived from the total proposals_count. voting.delay and voting.type can be null.
Read-only; SSRF-safe (upstream Snapshot host is fixed, caller passes only a space-id). Missing space -> HTTP 422, upstream failure -> HTTP 502.

Distinct same-host operation, NOT an alias: /governance/proposal ($0.02) returns ONE proposal + aggregate semantics; /governance/votes ($0.008) returns the per-voter ballot. Use this /governance/space route for the space's config/voting RULES.
usage.guide: Read a Snapshot DAO space's config and voting RULES in one paid call, so a governance agent knows the rules before reasoning about proposals. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/governance/space?space=<Snapshot space-id> (required — e.g. uniswapgovernance.eth, or a curated protocol alias like uniswap). No body, no API key. Pays $0.008 USDC via x402 on Base (challenge in the `payment-required` header). Returns the space's display name and about text, network and governance token symbol, a strategies summary, admin/moderator addresses, the voting config (delay, period, quorum, type), total proposal and follower counts, and a bucketed active/pending/closed proposal breakdown, plus Snapshot attribution. Verified live 2026-08-07 (paid 200, $0.008; Uniswap space: 197 proposals, quorum 10,000,000 UNI). For a single proposal's tally/quorum/projection use /governance/proposal; for the per-voter ballot use /governance/votes.

name: Agentstools Liquidations
description: On-chain DeFi liquidation telemetry for Base lending protocols — recent LiquidationCall events decoded from public Base event logs into count, total debt repaid and collateral seized (USD), estimated liquidation bonus, per-protocol and per-collateral-asset breakdown, plus the recent events (user, liquidator, collateral, debt).

protocol.description: Lending protocol to scan (default all sources)

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/lending/liquidations?protocol=<protocol>&window=<window> (both query params optional; default protocol=all sources, window=6h). No body. x402 v2 on Base USDC, $0.05. Synchronous — the 200 body carries the telemetry inline.

name: Agentstools Lending Markets

asset.description: Token symbol to filter markets by, e.g. USDC / ETH (optional).

chain.description: Chain (default Base).

usage.guide: Get money-market protocol-health and solvency intelligence for a DeFi lending protocol on Base in one paid call. name: Agentstools Lending Rates

asset.description: Token symbol to fuse rates for, e.g. USDC / ETH / WETH; omit for all assets

chain.description: Chain (default Base)

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/lending/rates with optional query params asset (token symbol, e.g. USDC), chain (enum [Base], default Base) and side (supply|borrow|both, default both). usage.outputShape: query.{asset, chains[], side}; markets[].{protocol, chain, symbol, asset, pool_id, supply_apy, supply_reward_apy, net_supply_apy, borrow_apy, borrow_reward_apy, net_borrow_apy, ltv, borrow_factor, utilization, total_supply_usd, total_borrow_usd, available_liquidity_usd, tvl_usd, debt_ceiling_usd, borrowable, stablecoin}; best_safe_yield.{supply[], borrow[]} each entry adds safety_flags.{high_utilization, low_liquidity, low_supply_depth, safe}; market_count (int), truncated (bool), source (string), disclaimer (string), ts (Unix seconds).
