name: Agentstools Break-even
description: One-call ASIC-miner break-even and profitability analysis — daily/monthly BTC and USD revenue, power cost, net profit, margin, break-even electricity price and break-even BTC price (plus optional hardware payback) for a named miner model or raw hashrate/wattage, fused with live hashprice and network difficulty.

model.description: ASIC model id from GET /mining/asics (such as antminer-s21 or whatsminer-m60); alternative to th_s and watts

th_s.description: Raw hashrate in TH/s; use with watts instead of a model

watts.description: Raw wall power in watts; use with th_s instead of a model

electricity_usd_kwh.description: Electricity price in USD per kWh; defaults to 0.05

pool_fee_pct.description: Mining-pool fee percent from 0 to 100; defaults to 0

hardware_cost_usd.description: Optional hardware cost in USD to compute payback days

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/mining/breakeven with query params — EITHER model (an ASIC model id from the free GET /mining/asics table, e.g. model=antminer-s21) OR raw th_s + watts; plus optional electricity_usd_kwh (default 0.05), pool_fee_pct (default 0) and hardware_cost_usd (for payback days). No request body. Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453). Result is returned inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: model.{id,name,th_s,watts,release_year}; inputs.{th_s,watts,electricity_usd_kwh,pool_fee_pct,hardware_cost_usd}; breakeven.{th_s,watts,efficiency_j_th,electricity_usd_kwh,pool_fee_pct,daily_btc,monthly_btc,kwh_per_day,power_cost_usd_day,power_cost_usd_month,revenue_usd_day,revenue_usd_month,net_usd_day,net_usd_month,margin_percent,profitable,breakeven_electricity_usd_kwh,breakeven_btc_price_usd,payback_days}; hashprice.{hashprice_btc_per_th_day,hashprice_usd_per_th_day}; price_usd; difficulty; block_height; sources.{errors,partial,providers}; attribution[]; disclaimer.
quirks: All input is OPTIONAL query params. Supply EITHER a model id (from the free GET /mining/asics table) OR a raw th_s + watts pair; if none are given it falls back to defaults. There is no request body.
electricity_usd_kwh defaults to 0.05 and pool_fee_pct to 0; payback_days is null unless hardware_cost_usd is supplied.
hashprice, price_usd, difficulty and block_height are pulled live at call time (mempool.space), so break-even figures change every block even for a fixed model.
ASIC specs (th_s, watts, efficiency) are nominal manufacturer datasheet figures; the value-add is the deterministic computation fused with live network data, not a data resale.
Provider labels output as informational only, NOT financial advice and NOT a guarantee of profit.
usage.guide: Compute ASIC-miner break-even and profitability in one paid call. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/mining/breakeven?model=antminer-s21&electricity_usd_kwh=0.05 (or use th_s + watts for a raw machine; add pool_fee_pct and hardware_cost_usd for pool-net figures and payback days). Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base. Returns the machine spec, daily/monthly mined BTC and fiat revenue, electricity cost, net profit and margin, plus the two decision figures: break-even electricity price and break-even BTC price, all fused with live hashprice/difficulty. Verified live: model=antminer-s21 @ $0.05/kWh returned net_usd_day 2.32, margin 35.6%, breakeven_electricity_usd_kwh 0.0776, breakeven_btc_price_usd 41839 at BTC price 64963, block_height 961498.

name: Agentstools Mining Capitulation
description: Bitcoin hash-ribbon miner-capitulation signal: 30-day vs 60-day network-hashrate moving averages, whether miners are in capitulation, whether a recovery cross has occurred, and the 30-day hashrate trend.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/mining/capitulation with no query params and no request body. Pays $0.008 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453). Result is returned inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: hash_ribbon.{days_observed,ma_short_days,ma_long_days,sma_short_ehs,sma_long_ehs,current_hashrate_ehs,in_capitulation(bool),recovery_cross(bool),signal(capitulation|recovery|neutral),hashrate_trend_30d_percent}; difficulty_adjustment.{progress_percent,difficulty_change_percent,estimated_retarget_date_ms,remaining_blocks,next_retarget_height}; current_difficulty(number); sources.{errors,partial,providers[]}; attribution[]; disclaimer.
quirks: No input at all: it is a GET with no query params and no request body; the signal is computed relative to the current network state at call time.

hash_ribbon compares the 30-day (ma_short_days) vs 60-day (ma_long_days) moving average of network hashrate (EH/s); in_capitulation=true when the short MA is below the long MA, signal reports 'capitulation' / 'recovery' accordingly, and recovery_cross flags a short-above-long crossback.
Data is sourced from mempool.space (AGPL-3.0) fused with ASIC datasheet specs; sources.partial=true and sources.errors populate when a source is briefly unavailable.
Provider labels output as informational only, NOT financial advice; hashrate/difficulty change every block so values differ on each call.
Verified live: signal 'capitulation', in_capitulation=true, sma_short_ehs 898.14 vs sma_long_ehs 916.91, current_hashrate_ehs 794.17, hashrate_trend_30d_percent -15.38.
usage.guide: Check whether Bitcoin miners are capitulating in one paid call. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/mining/capitulation (no params, no body). Pays $0.008 USDC via x402 on Base. Returns a hash-ribbon read: the 30-day vs 60-day network-hashrate moving averages (sma_short_ehs / sma_long_ehs), current hashrate (current_hashrate_ehs), whether miners are in_capitulation, whether a recovery_cross has occurred, the classified signal, and the 30-day hashrate trend percent, plus current difficulty-adjustment context. Data cited to mempool.space; informational only, not financial advice. Verified live: signal 'capitulation' with the 30d MA (898 EH/s) below the 60d MA (917 EH/s) and a -15.4% 30-day hashrate trend.

name: Agentstools Prediction Event
description: Cross-venue prediction-market event fusion: given a free-text event query (or a venue market_id + venue anchor), it clusters the SAME event across Polymarket, Manifold and Metaculus via deterministic fuzzy title match + resolve-date proximity and returns each venue's implied probability with a match score, a single money-type-weighted consensus probability, a forecast-divergence signal (spread/stdev, labelled disagreement not arbitrage), and aggregated volume/liquidity. Keyless pay-per-call over x402.

query.description: The event to fuse across venues (free text). Supply this OR (market_id + venue). Passed as a URL query param; no request body.

market_id.description: Optional venue market id to seed the anchor market instead of a free-text query.

venue.description: Optional venue key that pairs with market_id.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/prediction/event?query=<free-text event> — supply the event as a single URL query param (or seed with market_id + venue); no request body. Pays $0.02 USDC via x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453), keyless. Result is inline in the 200 JSON body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: Sync JSON: query, event{question, n_venues, consensus_probability{probability, n_markets, weighting ('by money_type (real > forecast > play)')}, divergence (null when only one venue matched, else {spread, stdev, note:'disagreement, not arbitrage'}), aggregated_volume, aggregated_liquidity, per_venue[] each {venue, venue_name, money_type (real|play|forecast), attribution, id, question, outcomes[]{name,prob}, implied_prob, implied_outcome, match_score, volume, liquidity, close_date, status, link}}, summary{venues_ok, venues_failed, total_fetched, matched_venues, errors[]}, attribution[], disclaimer.
quirks: Input is URL query params on a GET (query, or market_id+venue); no request body. Both `query` and `market_id`/`venue` are individually optional in the OpenAPI but you must supply one path — the free-text `query` is the documented example.

The consensus is a money-type-weighted probability (real-money markets weigh more than forecast/play); the divergence signal is the spread/stdev of venue probabilities and is honestly labelled 'disagreement, not arbitrage' — venues differ in money type, liquidity and resolution.

divergence is null when only one venue matches the event (verified: the paid example returned matched_venues=1, n_venues=1, divergence=null) — it only populates when the SAME event is clustered across 2+ venues.

The fuzzy-match anchor drifts with live market state: the paid example query 'will X win the 2028 election' resolved to a real live Polymarket event ('Will no qualifying diplomatic US-Iran meeting occur by September 30, 2026?') on the day — the returned question is what the matcher anchored to, not a literal echo of the query.

Venues configured: Polymarket (real-money, Gamma API / on-chain USDC on Polygon) + Manifold (play-money) + Metaculus (forecast, when a token is configured). A down venue is reported under summary.errors and the rest still return (never a 500); a total upstream failure is a 502; nothing matched is a 422.
The 402 body is empty {}; the x402 challenge (accepts + bazaar input/output schema) is carried in the 'payment-required' response header (base64 JSON).
Amount is fixed: the live 402 quotes exactly 20000 atomic USDC = $0.02 on Base (asset 0x833589..., payTo 0xF22e558a...); no Solana option, no API key / no sign-in.
usage.guide: Fuse one event across prediction venues in a single keyless x402 call. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/prediction/event?query=<free-text event> (or seed with market_id + venue), pay $0.02 USDC via x402 on Base (no API key). Read the 200 JSON directly: event.consensus_probability gives a single money-type-weighted probability (real-money markets weighted above forecast/play); event.divergence gives the spread/stdev of venue probabilities as a disagreement signal (null when only one venue matched — explicitly NOT a tradeable arbitrage); event.per_venue[] lists each matched venue's market with implied_prob, implied_outcome, match_score, outcomes[], volume, liquidity, close_date and a link-back; summary tells you venues_ok / matched_venues / errors. Data is computed from Polymarket (Gamma API, on-chain Polygon USDC) + Manifold + Metaculus — market data only, not financial advice; show the returned attribution/disclaimer. Verified live 2026-08-07 with query 'will X win the 2028 election' -> HTTP 200, $0.02 charged (matched 1 venue, consensus 0.2725, full per_venue payload).

name: Agentstools Prediction Search
description: Cross-venue prediction-market search: one free-text query returns a ranked list of normalized markets from Polymarket (real-money) and Manifold (play-money) — implied probability, outcomes, volume, liquidity, close date, status, money_type and a link-back — so play-money odds are never mistaken for real-money bets.

query.description: Topic or free-text query to search markets for (required).

venue.description: Optional: restrict to one venue by key.

limit.description: Max markets to return (default 15, cap 25).

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/prediction/search?query=<TEXT> with required query param `query`; optional `venue` (polymarket|manifold|metaculus) and `limit` (1-25, default 15). No request body. Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453). Result is returned inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: query (string echo), count (int), markets[] each with venue, venue_name, money_type (real/play/forecast), attribution, id, question, outcomes[]{name,prob}, implied_prob (number), implied_outcome (string), volume (number), liquidity (number), close_date (ISO 8601), status (e.g. open), link (source URL); summary{venues_ok,venues_failed,total_fetched,errors[]}; attribution[]; disclaimer (string). Ranked real-money-and-volume first.
quirks: `query` is REQUIRED and passed as a query param on a GET (no body); omitting it 4xx
`limit` is capped at 25 (default 15); values above 25 are clamped
money_type distinguishes real (Polymarket USDC on Polygon) from play (Manifold mana) from forecast (Metaculus) — a play-money probability is not a real-money bet
Metaculus results only appear when the provider has a Metaculus token configured; a live probe returned only Polymarket + Manifold venues
A down venue is reported under summary.errors and the rest still return (never a 500); total upstream failure is a 502; an empty result set is a 422
Data about markets only — no trading, no resolution oracle; every response carries a not-financial-advice disclaimer
usage.guide: Cross-venue prediction-market search for research, forecasting and trading agents. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/prediction/search?query=<TEXT> (required `query`; optional `venue`=polymarket|manifold|metaculus, `limit`=1-25 default 15). No body. Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base. Returns a ranked list of markets normalized into one schema across Polymarket (real-money) and Manifold (play-money), each with venue, money_type, question, outcomes[]{name,prob}, implied_prob + implied_outcome, volume, liquidity, close_date, status and a link-back — ranked real-money-and-volume first. Verified live: query=election returned count 10 (e.g. 'Will Trump endorse Likud in the 2026 Israeli Election?' implied_prob 0.665, volume 17758, close 2026-10-28), summary.venues_ok 2, total_fetched 30.

chain.description: Filter to stablecoins present on this chain, such as Base

limit.description: Max rows to return (ranked by circulating)

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/stablecoin/list with OPTIONAL query params: pegMechanism (fiat-backed|crypto-backed|algorithmic), chain (e.g. Base), limit (1-500). No request body. Pays $0.005 USDC via x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453). Result is returned inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: count; total_matched; filters{pegMechanism,chain}; stablecoins[]{symbol,name,llama_id,pegType,pegMechanism,circulating_total,price,chains[]}; provenance{source,dataset}; attribution[]; disclaimer.

pegMechanism=fiat-backed and limit=5 are the provider's documented example values; pegMechanism enum is fiat-backed | crypto-backed | algorithmic; limit is 1-500.

usage.guide: List the covered stablecoins ranked by circulating market cap. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/stablecoin/list (optionally ?pegMechanism=fiat-backed&chain=Base&limit=5). No body. Pays $0.005 USDC via x402 on Base. name: Agentstools Perps
description: Return every open Hyperliquid perpetual position held by a single EVM address — per-position direction, size, USD notional, leverage, entry/mark price, unrealized PnL, ROE and liquidation price, plus derived account signals (account leverage, aggregate uPnL, concentration and a deterministic 0-100 liquidation-risk score).

address.description: A 0x-prefixed 40-hex EVM address (the wallet to profile). The upstream host is fixed server-side; you pass only this address.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/trader/perps?address=<0x EVM address>. Required query param: address (a 0x-prefixed 40-hex EVM wallet). No request body. x402 v2 on Base USDC (eip155:8453), $0.10. Result is inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: address (string echo), account { account_value, total_notional, total_margin_used, withdrawable } (USD), positions[] (each: coin, direction long|short, size_coins, notional_usd, leverage, leverage_type cross|isolated, entry_px, mark_px, unrealized_pnl, roe, liquidation_px (nullable), distance_to_liq_pct (nullable), max_leverage, margin_used), num_positions (int), signals { account_leverage, aggregate_upnl, concentration (largest position's share of gross notional), liq_risk_score (0-100), liq_risk_verdict }, source, chain ('Hyperliquid L1 (HyperCore)'), partial (bool), errors[], ts (Unix seconds), disclaimer, attribution
quirks: address is REQUIRED and passed as a query param on a GET (no body); a malformed address returns 400, an upstream failure 502 (never 500)
An address with no open positions returns an empty positions[] with num_positions 0 — not an error
liquidation_px and distance_to_liq_pct can be null for some positions (e.g. cross-margin longs where no liquidation price is implied)
direction is derived from the sign of the signed size; leverage_type distinguishes cross vs isolated margin
liq_risk_score is a deterministic 0-100 formula (notional-weighted proximity to liquidation), documented in the sibling /trader/sources — no model/LLM, reproducible
ts is Unix SECONDS (not ms). Public Hyperliquid on-chain (HyperCore) data — informational only, not financial advice
This is the address/wallet axis (what one trader holds); for market-wide funding rate / open interest use a separate perps market-data feed
usage.guide: Profile every open Hyperliquid perpetual position for a single EVM wallet in one paid call. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/trader/perps?address=<0x EVM address> (required query param address; no body). Pay $0.10 x402 USDC on Base (eip155:8453), no API key — settle the 402 quote and re-request; the result is inline in the synchronous 200 body. Returns account totals (account_value, total_notional, total_margin_used, withdrawable), positions[] (each with coin, direction, size_coins, notional_usd, leverage + cross/isolated type, entry_px, mark_px, unrealized_pnl, roe, liquidation_px, distance_to_liq_pct, max_leverage, margin_used), and derived signals (account_leverage, aggregate_upnl, concentration, a deterministic 0-100 liq_risk_score + verdict). Read from Hyperliquid's public keyless Info API (clearinghouseState) — decentralized on-chain state, not a resold CEX feed, not PII. Use it for follow-the-smart-money wallet intelligence and liquidation-risk monitoring; it complements market-wide funding/OI feeds. Verified live 2026-08-07: address 0xf5d81a...ad53 returned 18 positions, account_value ~$1.14M, liq_risk_score 0/verdict 'moderate'. Public data, not financial advice.

name: Agentstools Polymarket Trader
description: Polymarket wallet intelligence for a single EVM address: open positions (title, outcome, size, avg vs current price, current value, realized + unrealized PnL, redeemable), portfolio value, recent trade activity, derived totals, and size-weighted conviction/concentration/win-proxy signals — computed from Polymarket's public data-api over on-chain USDC prediction markets on Polygon. Keyless pay-per-call over x402.

address.description: A 0x-prefixed 40-hex EVM address (the wallet to profile). Passed as a URL query param. Hosts/data sources are fixed server-side; you supply only this address.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/trader/polymarket?address=<0x-EVM-address> — the wallet address is a single URL query param; no request body. Pays $0.10 USDC via x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453), keyless. Result is inline in the 200 JSON body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: Sync JSON: address, open_positions[] (each {title, outcome, size, avg_price, cur_price, current_value, unrealized, realized, redeemable}), portfolio_value (number), recent_activity[] (each {type: TRADE|REDEEM|MERGE|MAKER_REBATE|TAKER_REBATE|..., side: BUY|SELL|'', size, usdc, price, timestamp (unix), title, outcome}), totals{total_unrealized, total_realized, num_open}, signals{conviction, concentration, win_proxy} (numbers 0-1 or null when the wallet has no open positions), money_type ('real'), source, chain ('Polygon'), partial (bool), errors[], ts (unix), disclaimer, attribution.
quirks: Input is a single URL query param `address` (0x-prefixed 40-hex EVM address) on a GET; no request body.
Data is Polymarket public data-api over on-chain USDC prediction markets on Polygon — read-only public state, not a resold centralized-exchange feed.

When the wallet has no open positions, open_positions is [], portfolio_value is 0, totals are all 0, and signals.conviction/concentration/win_proxy are all null — but recent_activity and realized history are still returned (verified: the paid example address had 0 open positions yet a full recent_activity trade/redeem log).
recent_activity mixes trade fills (type TRADE, side BUY/SELL) with non-trade ledger events (REDEEM, MERGE, MAKER_REBATE, TAKER_REBATE) where side is '' and price 0.
The 402 body is empty {}; the x402 challenge (accepts + bazaar input/output schema) is carried in the 'payment-required' response header (base64 JSON).
Amount is dynamic-free / fixed: the live 402 quotes exactly 100000 atomic USDC = $0.10 on Base (asset 0x833589..., payTo 0xF22e558a...); no Solana option, no API key / no sign-in.
usage.guide: Profile a Polymarket wallet in one keyless x402 call. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/trader/polymarket?address=<0x EVM address>, pay $0.10 USDC via x402 on Base (no API key). Read the 200 JSON directly: open_positions[] gives each live market position (title, outcome, size, avg_price vs cur_price, current_value, realized + unrealized PnL, redeemable); portfolio_value is the mark-to-market total; totals{total_unrealized,total_realized,num_open} rolls it up; signals{conviction,concentration,win_proxy} are size-weighted derived scores (null when there are no open positions); recent_activity[] is the recent trade/redeem/merge/rebate ledger with timestamps. Data is computed from Polymarket's public data-api over on-chain Polygon USDC markets — public informational data, not financial advice; show the returned attribution/disclaimer. Verified live 2026-08-07 with address 0xfcdc071df7080c214196bb0b3b751e5417f9d8e3 -> HTTP 200, $0.10 charged (0 open positions, full recent_activity log returned).

name: Agentstools Trader Vaults
description: Hyperliquid vaults in one route: a ranked discovery list of the top open vaults by TVL or APR, or a single vault's overview (name, leader, TVL, APR, age, max drawdown, PnL trend and a 0-100 quality score) when a vault address is passed, from public on-chain data.

backends.inputSchema: Query params (GET, no body): vault (string, optional) — 0x EVM vault address; present => single-vault overview, absent => ranked top-vaults discovery list. sort (string, optional, enum tvl|apr, default tvl) — ranking key for the discovery list. limit (integer 1-100, optional, default 20) — top-N for the discovery list.
backends.outputSchema: List mode: { mode ('list'), sort ('tvl'|'apr'), count (int), vaults[] { name, vault_address, leader, tvl (number, USD), apr (number, fractional e.g. 0.25 = 25%), is_closed (bool) }, source, chain, partial (bool), errors[], ts (unix seconds), disclaimer, attribution }. Single-vault mode (vault passed): overview with name, leader, TVL, APR, age, max drawdown, PnL trend and a deterministic 0-100 quality score.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/trader/vaults with optional query params. Omit vault for a ranked discovery list: ?sort=tvl|apr (default tvl) & limit=1-100 (default 20). Pass ?vault=<0x EVM address> for a single-vault overview (sort/limit ignored). No request body, no API key. Pays a fixed $0.10 USDC via x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453). Synchronous — the JSON result is inline in the 200 body. The 402 challenge (accepts + bazaar input/output schema) is delivered in the base64 'payment-required' response header; the 402 body is empty {}.
usage.outputShape: mode='list'; sort='tvl'; count=20; vaults[] each = { name, vault_address (0x), leader (0x), tvl (USD number), apr (fractional, can be negative), is_closed (bool) }; source ('Hyperliquid public vaults stats feed (decentralized perp DEX)'); chain ('Hyperliquid L1 (HyperCore)'); partial=false; errors=[]; ts (unix seconds); disclaimer; attribution. Verified live: top vault Hyperliquidity Provider (HLP) at tvl 215,372,166.62 / apr 0.00247.
quirks: Two modes in one route: omit `vault` for a ranked discovery list; pass `vault`=<0x address> for a single-vault overview (name/leader/TVL/APR/age/max-drawdown/PnL-trend + a deterministic 0-100 quality score). sort/limit only apply to the list mode.
apr is a FRACTION, not a percent (0.25 = 25%), and can be negative (verified: several vaults had negative apr at index time).
The x402 402 challenge is in the base64-encoded 'payment-required' response HEADER (x402 v2) — the 402 body is an empty {} object; a naive body-only accepts parser sees nothing.
Public on-chain data only (Hyperliquid public Info API + stats CDN), not financial advice; centralized-exchange feeds are explicitly excluded per the response attribution.
A single index-time payment intermittently 402'd once before settling on retry; the fixed price is $0.10.
usage.guide: Discover or inspect Hyperliquid vaults. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/trader/vaults — omit `vault` for a ranked leaderboard of the top open vaults (?sort=tvl|apr, default tvl; ?limit=1-100, default 20), or pass ?vault=<0x EVM address> for a single vault's overview (name, leader, TVL, APR, age, max drawdown, PnL trend and a 0-100 quality score). No body, no API key. Pays a fixed $0.10 USDC via x402 on Base. Returns JSON: list mode gives vaults[] {name, vault_address, leader, tvl (USD), apr (fractional, can be negative), is_closed} sorted by the chosen key, plus source/chain/ts/attribution. Data is public on-chain Hyperliquid state (not financial advice). Verified live: 20 vaults, top HLP at $215.4M TVL.

name: Agentstools Bitcoin Address
description: Balance and unspent outputs for a Bitcoin address in one paid call: confirmed and mempool balance, funded and spent totals, transaction count, and a capped UTXO set for legacy, p2sh or bech32 addresses.

address.description: Bitcoin mainnet address (legacy 1.., p2sh 3.., or bech32 bc1..)

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/btc/address?address=<btc-address> with a REQUIRED query param address (legacy 1.., p2sh 3.., or bech32 bc1.. mainnet address). No request body. Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453). Result is returned inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: address; balance.{confirmed_sat,confirmed_btc,unconfirmed_sat,unconfirmed_btc,total_sat,total_btc}; funded_txo_sum_sat; spent_txo_sum_sat; tx_count; mempool_tx_count; utxo_count; utxos[].{txid,vout,value_sat,value_btc,confirmed,block_height}; utxos_truncated; sources.{errors,partial,providers}; attribution[]; disclaimer.
quirks: address is a REQUIRED query param; there is no request body. It accepts legacy (1..), p2sh (3..) or bech32 (bc1..) Bitcoin MAINNET addresses only.
The UTXO set is capped: check utxos_truncated — when true the utxos[] array is a partial view even though balance/tx_count/utxo_count reflect the full address.
confirmed vs unconfirmed (mempool) balance are reported separately; mempool_tx_count and unconfirmed_sat cover pending activity.

Data is fused from public Bitcoin explorers (mempool.space primary, Blockstream Esplora fallback); sources.partial=true and sources.errors populate when a source is briefly unavailable. Provider labels output informational only, not financial advice.
usage.guide: Get the balance and UTXOs of any Bitcoin address in one paid call. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/btc/address?address=bc1q... (legacy 1.., p2sh 3.., or bech32 bc1.. mainnet). Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base. Returns confirmed + unconfirmed (mempool) balance in sat and BTC, funded/spent txo totals, tx_count and mempool_tx_count, utxo_count, and the UTXO set (txid, vout, value, confirmed, block_height) — watch utxos_truncated when the set is large. Verified live: bc1qgdjq...jwvw97 returned confirmed_btc 130010.079, tx_count 337, utxo_count 49, utxos_truncated false, sources.providers ['mempool.space'].

name: Agentstools Bitcoin Mempool
description: Live Bitcoin mempool snapshot: unconfirmed transaction count, total virtual size and total fees, a fee-rate histogram bucketed by sat/vB, and an estimated block backlog.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/btc/mempool with NO input (no query params, no body). Pays $0.005 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453). Result returned inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: mempool_tx_count (int); mempool_vsize (int, total vbytes); mempool_total_fee_sat (int, total pending fees in sats); estimated_backlog_blocks (number); fee_histogram[] of {fee_rate_sat_vb (number), vsize (int)}; sources.{errors,partial,providers[]}; attribution[]; disclaimer.
quirks: No input of any kind — GET the bare URL. The x402 bazaar schema lists methods GET/HEAD/DELETE and an empty queryParams object; only GET returns data.
fee_histogram is a large array of {fee_rate_sat_vb, vsize} buckets ordered from highest to lowest fee rate (~230 buckets observed); use it to gauge congestion at a target fee rate.
Data is sourced from mempool.space (AGPL-3.0), fused with Blockstream Esplora fallback; sources.partial=true and sources.errors populate when a source is briefly unavailable.
Provider labels output informational only, not financial advice; mempool state changes every block.
usage.guide: Get a live Bitcoin mempool snapshot in one keyless x402 call. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/btc/mempool with no params and no body. Pays $0.005 USDC via x402 on Base. Synchronous — the 200 body carries the unconfirmed transaction count (mempool_tx_count), total pending virtual size (mempool_vsize), total pending fees in sats (mempool_total_fee_sat), an estimated block backlog (estimated_backlog_blocks), and a fee-rate histogram (fee_histogram[] of {fee_rate_sat_vb, vsize} buckets, high-to-low), all derived from mempool.space. Verified live 2026-08-07: HTTP 200, $0.005 charged, mempool_tx_count 83827, mempool_vsize 42571023, mempool_total_fee_sat 13225001, estimated_backlog_blocks 42.57, ~230 histogram buckets, sources.providers ['mempool.space'].

name: Agentstools Bitcoin Transaction
description: Decoded view of a Bitcoin transaction by txid — version, locktime, size/weight/vsize, fee (sat and BTC) and derived fee rate, BIP-125 replace-by-fee flag, input/output counts and values, per-input/output details, and confirmation status with a confirmation count derived from the current chain tip.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/btc/tx?txid=<64-hex Bitcoin transaction id>. Required query param: txid. No request body. Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453), no API key. Result is returned inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: txid; version; locktime; size_bytes; weight; vsize; fee_sat; fee_btc; fee_rate_sat_vb; rbf; input_count; output_count; total_input_sat; total_output_sat; inputs[].{txid,vout,is_coinbase,value_sat,address}; inputs_truncated; outputs[].{value_sat,value_btc,address,type}; outputs_truncated; status.{confirmed,block_height,block_hash,block_time,confirmations}; sources.{errors,partial,providers}; attribution[]; disclaimer.
quirks: Single required query param txid (64 hex). No request body.
confirmations is derived relative to the CURRENT chain tip at call time, so it increases every block for a fixed txid.
For a coinbase transaction, the single input has is_coinbase=true with value_sat/total_input_sat null (and thus fee_sat 0); inputs/outputs are each capped for anti-abuse with a *_truncated flag.
Reads use the Esplora REST schema with mempool.space primary and Blockstream Esplora fallback; sources.partial/errors populate when a source is briefly unavailable.
Informational only, not financial advice; distinct from the EVM /tx lookup and from btc/block.
usage.guide: Decode a Bitcoin transaction by its txid in one keyless paid call. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/btc/tx?txid=<64-hex tx id>. No body. Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453), no API key — pay the 402 quote and re-request; result is inline in the synchronous 200 body. Returns version, locktime, size_bytes/weight/vsize, fee_sat/fee_btc and derived fee_rate_sat_vb, BIP-125 rbf flag, input/output counts and total values, per-input details (previous txid, vout, is_coinbase, value_sat, address) and per-output details (value_sat/value_btc, address, script type), plus confirmation status (confirmed, block_height, block_hash, block_time, confirmations from the current tip). Verified live: txid 4a5e1e...da33b (Bitcoin genesis coinbase) returned version 1, size 204, vsize 204, output 50 BTC (p2pk), status.confirmed true, block_height 0, block_hash 000...26f, confirmations 961499, source mempool.space.

name: Agentstools ABI Encode/Decode
description: ABI helper for EVM: build calldata for a function call (keccak selector + abi-encoded args from a signature like transfer(address,uint256)), abi-encode a list of types+args to 0x bytes, or decode 0x bytes back into values — pure local computation.

op.description: Operation: encode_call builds calldata for a function (needs signature+args); encode abi-encodes types+args to 0x bytes; decode parses 0x bytes back into values

signature.description: Function signature for op=encode_call, e.g. transfer(address,uint256)

usage.callShape: POST https://api.agentstools.dev/crypto/abi with a JSON body {op, signature?, types?, args?, data?}. op is required and selects the mode. Pays $0.003 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453). Result is returned inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: For op=encode_call: {selector (0x-hex 4-byte selector), calldata (0x-hex full calldata)}. For op=encode: {data (0x-hex abi bytes)}. For op=decode: decoded values (bytes as 0x-hex, big ints as strings).
quirks: op is a required discriminator: encode_call needs signature + args; encode needs types + args; decode needs data (0x bytes).
Tuple/nested types are NOT supported yet — such requests return HTTP 400.
Pure local computation (no chain call): output is deterministic for the same input.
usage.guide: Build or parse EVM ABI calldata in one paid call. POST https://api.agentstools.dev/crypto/abi with a JSON body. Set op=encode_call plus signature (e.g. transfer(address,uint256)) and args to get the 4-byte selector and full calldata; op=encode with types+args to abi-encode to 0x bytes; op=decode with data (0x bytes) to parse values back out. Pays $0.003 USDC via x402 on Base. Pure local computation, no chain call. Tuple/nested types are not supported (400). Verified live: transfer(address,uint256) with args [0x5290...9EE7, 1000000] returned selector 0xa9059cbb and its full calldata.

name: Agentstools Crypto Hash
description: Compute a keccak256 or sha256 digest, a 4-byte EVM function selector, an event topic0, or an ENS namehash/labelhash from a string, function/event signature, ENS name, or 0x-hex input — one paid call, no key.

algo.description: Input/filter query param (name from the provider's own example; added during baked-query remediation so it stays discoverable).

input.description: Input/filter query param (name from the provider's own example; added during baked-query remediation so it stays discoverable).

encoding.description: How to read `input` for keccak256/sha256 (default utf8).

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/crypto/hash?algo=<ALGO>&input=<VALUE> with required query params algo (one of keccak256|sha256|selector|event_topic|namehash|labelhash) and input, plus optional encoding (utf8|hex, for keccak256/sha256 only). No body. Pays $0.001 USDC via x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453). Result is returned inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: {algo (echoes the requested algorithm), hash (0x-prefixed result — a 4-byte selector for 'selector', a 32-byte topic0 for 'event_topic', a full 32-byte digest for keccak256/sha256/namehash/labelhash)}
quirks: algo and input are BOTH required and passed as query params on a GET (no body); omitting either 4xx.

algo enum: keccak256, sha256, selector (4-byte function selector, e.g. transfer(address,uint256) -> 0xa9059cbb), event_topic (event signature -> topic0), namehash (ENS namehash), labelhash (ENS labelhash).
encoding (utf8|hex) only affects how `input` is read for keccak256/sha256; default is utf8.
Pure deterministic compute over public inputs — no chain reads, no key, no signing.
The live 402 self-identifies the service as 'crypto-hash' under the Agentstools host.
usage.guide: Compute EVM/crypto hashes in one paid call. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/crypto/hash?algo=<ALGO>&input=<VALUE> where algo is keccak256|sha256|selector|event_topic|namehash|labelhash and input is the string/signature/ENS name/0x-hex to hash (optional encoding=utf8|hex for keccak256/sha256). No body. Pays $0.001 USDC via x402 on Base. Returns {algo, hash}. Verified live: algo=selector, input='transfer(address,uint256)' returned hash 0xa9059cbb (the correct 4-byte function selector).

name: Agentstools DEX Swaps
description: Recent DEX swap history plus buy/sell flow for a Base token or pool, decoded from public Aerodrome/Uniswap-V3 Swap event logs — per-swap trader/side/amounts/price/USD-volume plus a window summary (counts, buy/sell/net volume, largest swaps).

token.description: Base token symbol (e.g. WETH/AERO); aggregates all its tracked pools. Provide token OR pool.

pool.description: Explicit pool address (0x..) instead of a token symbol.

limit.description: Max swaps to return (default/cap 500; summary always covers the full window).

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/dex/swaps with query params: token (Base symbol, e.g. WETH) OR pool (0x.. pool address); optional window (30m/1h/6h, default 1h) and limit (1-500, default/cap 500). No request body. x402 v2 on Base USDC, $0.01. Result is inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: query (echoed {token, pool}), pools[] ({pool address, dex 'aerodrome'|'univ3', pair, base, quote}), summary ({count, total_volume_usd, buy_count, sell_count, buy_volume_usd, sell_volume_usd, net_flow_usd (buy-sell USD), window_blocks, largest_swaps[]}), swaps[] (each {block, tx_hash, trader, side 'buy'|'sell', amount_base + amount_base_raw, amount_quote + amount_quote_raw, price, volume_usd, ts (Unix seconds), ts_estimated}), truncated (bool), block (int, tip), chain (CAIP-2, eip155:8453 = Base)
quirks: All params are query params on a GET (no body); provide token OR pool (a token symbol aggregates all its tracked pools)
window is capped at ~6h (30m/1h/6h); limit caps returned swaps at 500 but the summary always covers the full window
Only Base is supported; only Aerodrome (Velo-V2) and Uniswap-V3 pools are decoded
ts is Unix SECONDS; ts_estimated:true means the timestamp was derived from block height rather than an exact RPC read
Invalid token/pool returns a 400 (never a 500)
net_flow_usd is buy_volume_usd minus sell_volume_usd (positive = net buying pressure)
usage.guide: Get recent DEX swap history and buy/sell flow for a Base token or pool. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/dex/swaps?token=WETH&window=1h&limit=100 (or ?pool=0x.. for an explicit pool). No body. Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base. Returns the matched pools, a per-swap list (trader, side, base/quote amounts human+raw, execution price, USD volume, timestamp), and a window summary (total/buy/sell volume, net flow, counts, largest swaps). Decoded by the provider from public Aerodrome/Uniswap-V3 Swap event logs — no third-party key. Verified live: token=WETH window=1h returned 836 swaps, total_volume_usd ~$442,453, net_flow_usd +$25,217 across a WETH/USDC Aerodrome + Uniswap-V3 pool set.

name: Agentstools DEX Trending
description: Ranks tracked Base DEX pools by recent swap volume and net buy/sell flow over a short look-back window, computed from public Aerodrome and Uniswap-V3 Swap event logs.

limit.description: Max pools to return, ranked by volume (default all tracked)

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/dex/trending with OPTIONAL query params: window (look-back window string, e.g. 15m/30m/1h; default 30m, max ~1h) and limit (integer 1-6, max pools ranked by volume; default all tracked). No request body. Pays $0.05 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453). Result returned inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: {window_blocks, pools_scanned, trending[]:{pool (address), dex ('univ3'|'aerodrome'), pair, base, quote, swap_count, buy_count, sell_count, volume_usd, buy_volume_usd, sell_volume_usd, net_flow_usd}, block, ts (unix), chain (eip155:8453), cached}
quirks: All input is OPTIONAL query params (window, limit); passing neither returns all tracked pools over the default 30m window. There is no request body.
limit is capped at 6 (integer 1-6); window is capped at ~1h.
Base chain only (chain=eip155:8453). Coverage is limited to pools in the provider's tracked registry (pools_scanned reflects how many were scanned) and grows over time.
net_flow_usd is buy_volume_usd minus sell_volume_usd (can be negative). Computed entirely from public on-chain Aerodrome + Uniswap-V3 Swap logs, no third-party API resold.
Heaviest call in the provider's set; results are long TTL-cached (cached flag indicates a cache hit).
usage.guide: Get a ranked snapshot of trending Base DEX pools by recent swap volume and buy/sell flow. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/dex/trending?limit=5&window=30m (both params optional; window 15m/30m/1h, limit 1-6). Pays $0.05 USDC via x402 on Base. name: Agentstools Decode Signature
description: Reverse a 4-byte function selector, an event topic0 hash, or raw calldata into its human-readable ABI signature using the 4byte.directory database, returning the canonical (oldest-registered) signature first and flagging collision lookalikes.

selector.description: Input/filter query param (name from the provider's own example; added during baked-query remediation so it stays discoverable).

input.description: Raw calldata or hex; the first 4 bytes are taken as the selector (alternative to selector/topic0).

collision.description: true when multiple signatures share the selector.

candidates.description: All matching signatures ordered oldest-first; later entries are likely attacker-registered lookalikes.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/evm/decode-signature with exactly one of the query params: selector=<0x + 8 hex 4-byte selector>, topic0=<0x + 64 hex event topic hash>, or input=<raw hex calldata> (first 4 bytes used as the selector). No body. x402 v2 on Base USDC (eip155:8453), $0.003. Result is inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: input (echo), selector, topic0 (null unless an event topic was queried), input_kind (function_selector|event_topic|calldata), signature_type (function|event), found (bool), collision (bool — true when multiple signatures share the selector), canonical {text_signature, params[], id, created_at, canonical} (the oldest-registered, real signature), candidates[] (all matches oldest-first; later ones are likely lookalikes), candidate_count (int), attribution, disclaimer
quirks: Supply exactly one of selector (0x + 8 hex), topic0 (0x + 64 hex), or input (raw calldata) as a query param on the GET; no body
Data comes from the public 4byte.directory open signature DB; decoded deterministically (no LLM)
collision:true means several signatures hash to the same selector — canonical is the oldest registered (treated as the real one); the later candidates are often attacker-registered lookalikes
candidates[] is ordered oldest-first with created_at timestamps so you can spot recently-added lookalikes
Informational only — the response includes a disclaimer to verify anything security-critical yourself
Result is returned inline in the synchronous 200 (no polling)
usage.guide: Reverse an EVM 4-byte function selector, event topic0 hash, or raw calldata back to its human-readable ABI signature in one keyless paid call. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/evm/decode-signature with one query param: selector=<0x + 8 hex> (e.g. 0xa9059cbb), or topic0=<0x + 64 hex>, or input=<raw hex calldata> (first 4 bytes used). No body. Pays $0.003 USDC via x402 v2 on Base — pay the 402 quote and re-request; result is inline in the synchronous 200. Read canonical.text_signature for the real signature (e.g. transfer(address,uint256)); if collision:true, inspect candidates[] (oldest-first) since later entries are often attacker-registered lookalikes. Verified live 2026-08-07: selector 0xa9059cbb resolved to canonical transfer(address,uint256) with candidate_count 6.

name: Agentstools Farcaster Profile
description: One-call Farcaster profile fusion: give a username or fid and get the full profile (display name, bio, picture, url, socials), primary Ethereum address, every verified on-chain wallet, custody address, following/follower/cast counts, and account age — replacing four or five raw hub reads.

username.description: Farcaster username (fname or ENS), without the at-sign. Supply this OR fid.

fid.description: Farcaster ID (FID), a positive integer. Supply this OR username.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/farcaster/profile with ONE identity query param — ?username=<fname/ENS, no @> OR ?fid=<positive integer>. No request body, no API key. Pays a fixed $0.005 USDC via x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453, USDC 0x8335...2913, payTo 0xF22e...F493). Synchronous — the JSON result is inline in the 200 body. The 402 challenge (accepts + bazaar input/output schema) is delivered base64-encoded in the 'payment-required' response HEADER; the 402 body is nearly empty ({}).
usage.outputShape: found (bool), fid (int), username (string), profile ({display_name, twitter, bio, banner_url, pfp_url, url, username, primary_eth_address}), custody_address (0x), primary_eth_address (0x), verified_addresses[] ({address, protocol: ethereum|solana}), counts ({following:{count,capped}, followers_floor:{count,capped}, casts_floor:{count,capped}}), account_age_days (int), registered_at (unix seconds), attribution[] (data-source credits). Large accounts report followers_floor/casts_floor with capped=true (true count is higher). Unknown identity returns found=false; never a 500.
quirks: Supply exactly ONE of username / fid as a query param on a GET (no body).
Counts for large accounts are a FLOOR with capped=true — the true follower/cast count is higher than the reported number.
verified_addresses[] spans both Ethereum and Solana protocols.
Public Farcaster protocol data only (Snapchain public hub + fname registry).
Distinct from sibling ops /farcaster/resolve (identity/wallet resolver), /farcaster/reputation (score) and /farcaster/graph (follow graph) — this is the full fused profile.
usage.guide: Fetch a complete Farcaster profile in one keyless paid call. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/farcaster/profile with ONE identity query param — ?username=<fname> (e.g. ?username=dwr) or ?fid=<positive integer>. No body, no API key. Pays a fixed $0.005 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453). Returns JSON synchronously: found, fid, username, profile (display_name, twitter, bio, pfp_url, banner_url, url, primary_eth_address), custody_address, primary_eth_address, verified_addresses[] (ethereum + solana), counts (following / followers_floor / casts_floor, each {count, capped}), account_age_days, registered_at, attribution[]. Use it to fuse a Farcaster identity, its wallets, and its social footprint for enrichment, reputation, or anti-sybil checks. Verified live: username=dwr → fid 3 (Dan Romero), primary_eth 0x6Ce0...feA5, 1442 following, 10000+ followers (capped), account_age 1004 days.

name: Agentstools BTC DCA Signal
description: A single actionable Bitcoin DCA verdict (accumulate / hold / reduce) with confidence and rationale, fusing four keyless indicators — AHR999, the Mayer Multiple, the Crypto Fear & Greed index and the 200-week MA deviation — into a weighted composite score, and returning the per-indicator scores, weights, thresholds and raw input components.

asset.description: Optional asset key, default btc. DCA is Bitcoin-focused (AHR999 is Bitcoin-only); pass nothing for BTC.

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/timing/dca (optional query param asset=btc|eth, default btc). No body. x402 v2 on Base USDC, $0.03. Result is inline in the 200 body (synchronous).
usage.outputShape: asset (string echo, e.g. BTC), signal ('accumulate'|'hold'|'reduce'), confidence (number 0-1), rationale (string, human read of the blend), composite_score (number, weighted composite in [-1,1]), component_scores.{ahr999, mayer, fng, wma200} (per-indicator accumulation scores in [-1,1]), weights.{ahr999, mayer, fng, wma200} (blend weights, e.g. 0.35/0.25/0.2/0.2), components.{ahr999:{value,zone}, mayer:{value,zone}, wma200_pct_off (number, spot % vs 200-week MA), fear_greed (int 0-100), fear_greed_classification (string, e.g. 'Fear')}, thresholds.{accumulate_at, reduce_at}, note (string disclaimer), ts (int Unix SECONDS), attribution (string, DefiLlama + alternative.me)
quirks: No required input — a bare GET defaults to asset=btc; the asset param only accepts enum btc|eth and DCA is Bitcoin-focused (AHR999 is Bitcoin-only)
Deterministic multi-indicator fusion, NO LLM: signal = composite_score crossing fixed thresholds (accumulate_at 0.2, reduce_at -0.2)
A component that is unavailable is dropped and the weighted blend renormalizes over the remaining indicators rather than failing the response
The live 200 body carries MORE fields than the OpenAPI example — it also returns weights, thresholds, wma200_pct_off and fear_greed_classification observed on the verified call
ts is Unix SECONDS (not milliseconds); confidence blends composite magnitude with how strongly the four components agree
Intelligence, not financial advice — the note field carries this disclaimer on every response
usage.guide: A single actionable Bitcoin DCA (dollar-cost averaging) verdict for accumulation agents — the value-add fusion route over Agentstools' raw timing indicators. It blends FOUR keyless indicators into a normalized accumulate / hold / reduce signal: AHR999, the Mayer Multiple, the Crypto Fear & Greed index and the 200-week MA deviation. Each component maps its live value to an accumulation score in [-1, +1] (+1 = cheap/accumulate, -1 = expensive/reduce); a weighted blend (weights renormalized over available components) yields a composite score which crosses fixed thresholds (accumulate at 0.2, reduce at -0.2) into the verdict. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/timing/dca (optional query param asset=btc|eth, default btc; DCA is Bitcoin-focused). No body. x402 v2 on Base USDC, $0.03. Synchronous — the 200 body carries {asset, signal, confidence, rationale, composite_score, component_scores{ahr999,mayer,fng,wma200}, weights{...}, components{ahr999{value,zone}, mayer{value,zone}, wma200_pct_off, fear_greed, fear_greed_classification}, thresholds{accumulate_at,reduce_at}, note, ts, attribution}. Deterministic, formula in code, no LLM. Intelligence, not financial advice.

name: Agentstools Validator Lookup
description: Resolve a Solana validator identity pubkey to its vote-account (or the reverse) with commission, activated stake and delinquency, or return the top-N lowest-risk safe validators ranked by risk score then stake.

vote.description: Vote-account pubkey to resolve to its identity

identity.description: Node identity pubkey to resolve to its vote-account

top_n.description: Return this many lowest-risk safe validators

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/validator/lookup with OPTIONAL query params: vote (vote-account pubkey to resolve to its identity) OR identity (node identity pubkey to resolve to its vote-account) for pair resolution, OR top_n (integer 1-50) to get that many lowest-risk safe validators. No request body. Pays $0.008 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453). Result is returned inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: network (string, e.g. 'solana'); epoch (integer); resolved (null unless vote/identity given — then {vote_pubkey,identity_pubkey,commission_pct,activated_stake_sol,delinquent}); top_safe[] (present when top_n given — each {vote_pubkey,identity_pubkey,verdict,risk_score,commission_pct,activated_stake_sol}, ascending risk_score then descending stake, filtered to active non-delinquent vote accounts); disclaimer (string).
quirks: All input is OPTIONAL query params. Supply vote OR identity to resolve the identity<->vote-account pair, OR top_n for a ranked safe-validator shortlist. There is no request body.
top_safe is filtered to active, non-delinquent vote accounts with meaningful stake and ranked by ascending risk_score then descending activated_stake_sol; top_n is clamped to 1-50.
Data is a cluster-wide snapshot computed from keyless public Solana RPC; risk_score/verdict are risk indicators only, not financial or staking advice.
This is the light first step of a two-step flow — call the sibling /validator/vet on a chosen vote-account for the full weighted delegation-risk verdict with per-dimension reasons.
usage.guide: Map between a Solana validator's advertised node identity and the vote-account it delegates to, or get a shortlist of the safest validators to stake with, in one cheap paid call. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/validator/lookup?top_n=5 for the top-N lowest-risk safe validators (or ?vote=<vote-account> / ?identity=<node-identity> to resolve the pair). Pays $0.008 USDC via x402 on Base. Returns network, epoch, either resolved (the identity/vote pair with commission, activated stake and delinquency) or top_safe[] (each with vote_pubkey, identity_pubkey, verdict, risk_score, commission_pct, activated_stake_sol). Then call /validator/vet for the full weighted verdict. Verified live: top_n=5 (epoch 1013) returned 5 'safe' validators, all risk_score 0, e.g. vote shft7Fry1js37Hm9wq4dfwcZSp2DyKszeWMvEpjYCQ1 with 3,607,817.9 SOL activated.

name: Agentstools Validator Vet
description: Deterministic delegation-risk verdict (safe/caution/avoid/not_found) with a 0-100 risk score for a Solana validator, fusing delinquency, commission level, commission-rug history, skip-rate percentile, vote-credit performance, agent version lag and superminority concentration from public on-chain data.

vote.description: Vote-account pubkey of the validator (base58); supply this OR identity

identity.description: Node identity pubkey (base58); alternative to vote

usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentstools.dev/validator/vet with a query param identifying the validator: vote (vote-account pubkey, base58) OR identity (node identity pubkey, base58) — supply exactly one; optionally include_history=true for the accrued commission-history summary. No request body. Pays $0.02 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453). Result is returned inline in the 200 body (synchronous, no poll).
usage.outputShape: verdict (safe|caution|avoid|not_found); risk_score (0-100); network; validator.{vote_pubkey,identity_pubkey,commission_pct,inflation_commission_bps,activated_stake_sol,delinquent,epoch_vote_account,version,skip_rate,skip_rate_percentile,credit_percentile,in_superminority}; flags.{delinquency,commission_level,commission_rug,skip_rate,performance,version_lag,superminority}; signals[].{dimension,flag,weight,points,detail}; reasons[]; epoch; disclaimer.
quirks: Supply exactly one identifier — vote (vote-account) OR identity (node) pubkey; an unknown pubkey returns verdict 'not_found' rather than an error.
The risk_score is a deterministic weighted model (no LLM) that fuses seven dimensions; each fired signal returns its weight/points/flag/detail so an agent can re-rank with its own policy.
Cold-start aware: before this service accrues per-epoch commission history, the commission_rug dimension reports no_history (verified run showed 'stable').
Scores/flags are computed relative to the CURRENT epoch snapshot (refreshed in-process from keyless public Solana RPC), so they change over time for the same validator.
Risk indicators only, not financial or staking advice; verify independently before delegating.
usage.guide: Get a one-call Solana validator delegation-risk verdict before staking SOL. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/validator/vet?vote=<vote-account-pubkey> (or ?identity=<node-pubkey>, optionally &include_history=true). Pays $0.02 USDC via x402 on Base. Returns a verdict (safe/caution/avoid/not_found), a 0-100 risk_score, the validator snapshot (commission, activated stake, delinquency, version, skip-rate percentile, credit percentile, superminority), per-dimension flags and weighted signals (delinquency, commission level, commission-rug history, skip-rate, performance, version lag, superminority) with human-readable reasons. Tip: use Agentstools Validator Lookup first to resolve identity<->vote or get top-N safe candidates. Verified live: vote 8tjRQLzor4dP4qd1e7pVDdQmsdwdVv4kSeCVEHwWEiQW returned verdict 'safe', risk_score 0, commission 2%, 849209.5 SOL activated, epoch 1013.

name: x402stock Archive Day
description: Reads one immutable archived day of a market feed (sol.jlp, hl.perps, xstocks.premium, prestocks.markets, scores.squeeze, …) — the exact payload the live endpoint returned that UTC day, plus capture provenance and a content hash.

backends.inputSchema: Path param: feed (string, required, e.g. xstocks.premium, sol.jlp, hl.perps, prestocks.markets, scores.squeeze — see /api/v1/archive for the full catalog). Query params: date (string, optional, YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to latest archived day); entity (string, optional, on multi-entity feeds).
backends.outputSchema: { source:'x402stock', as_of, snapshot:{ feed, entity, observed_date, observed_at, captured_at, ingested_at, content_hash, summary:{...feed-specific}, payload:{...the exact live payload that day} } }

usage.callShape: GET https://agents.x402stock.xyz/api/v1/archive/:feed — :feed is a required URL path segment (e.g. xstocks.premium); optional ?date=YYYY-MM-DD and ?entity= query params; no request body; x402 USDC on Base

inputExample._note: feed is a URL path segment, not a JSON body. Omit ?date to get the latest archived day. GET, no request body.

usage.outputShape: source('x402stock'), as_of, snapshot:{ feed, entity, observed_date, observed_at, captured_at, ingested_at, content_hash, summary (feed-specific object), payload (the exact JSON the live endpoint returned that day) }. Verified xstocks.premium 200: snapshot.observed_date=2026-08-07, content_hash present, summary={count:10, us_market_open:false, median_premium_percent:0.0159}, payload.items[] each { symbol, underlying, pool, mint, xstock_price_usd, pool_price_raw_unit, multiplier, liquidity, tick_current, underlying_price_usd, underlying_change_percent, underlying_market_status, premium_percent }.
quirks: feed is a REQUIRED path segment — substitute a real feed name (xstocks.premium, sol.jlp, hl.perps, prestocks.markets, scores.squeeze, …). Call GET /api/v1/archive first (its own service) to discover the full feed catalog + date coverage.

Defaults to the LATEST archived day; pass ?date=YYYY-MM-DD for a past day. Snapshots are captured once per UTC day and never overwritten or backfilled, so history only exists from the day capture began.
?entity= selects one entity on multi-entity feeds; single-entity feeds return entity like '_market'.
snapshot.content_hash + captured_at/observed_at/ingested_at are provenance proving contemporaneous capture — the payload is the exact bytes the live endpoint returned that day.
snapshot.payload is feed-specific (its shape mirrors whatever that live feed returns); do not assume a fixed schema across feeds.
For day-by-day time-series summaries use the sibling /archive/:feed/range ($0.03); for a full single-day payload use this endpoint.
Sync — full snapshot returned inline in the 200 body, no polling.
usage.guide: Reads one immutable archived day of a market feed. Call GET https://agents.x402stock.xyz/api/v1/archive/:feed with the feed name as the final path segment (e.g. xstocks.premium, sol.jlp, hl.perps, prestocks.markets, scores.squeeze). Omit ?date for the latest archived day, or pass ?date=YYYY-MM-DD for a past day (?entity= on multi-entity feeds). No request body; pay $0.02 USDC on Base via x402. Response: { source:'x402stock', as_of, snapshot:{ feed, entity, observed_date, observed_at, captured_at, ingested_at, content_hash, summary, payload } } — snapshot.payload is the exact JSON the live feed returned that day; snapshot.content_hash + timestamps are capture provenance. Discover available feeds + date coverage via the sibling GET /api/v1/archive. Verified 2026-08-07 against feed=xstocks.premium: HTTP 200, observed_date 2026-08-07, 10 on-chain xStock price items.

name: x402stock Crypto Prev-Close
description: Previous UTC calendar day's full daily OHLCV candle (00:00-24:00 UTC) for a major-coin crypto spot pair (:pair as BASE-QUOTE, e.g. BTC-USD): open, high, low, close, volume, VWAP, and trade count. Crypto trades 24/7 so this is the prior UTC-day bar, not a session close. Verified body (BTC-USD): {ticker:'X:BTCUSD', data:{open:64603.02, high:65021, low:64087.41, close:64259.2, volume:7367.46501848, vwap:64532.5409, trade_count:510509, timestamp:'2026-08-06T23:59:59.999Z'}, source:'x402stock', as_of:...}.

billing.description: amount is the price and is charged in full when you pay, and is not returned if delivery fails: this rail settles once and cannot give change. (Exact entries appear only on fixed-price requests - ceiling-priced requests are offered the reserve-and-pay-actual entry instead.)

pair.description: Currency or crypto spot pair as BASE-QUOTE, e.g. BTC-USD or ETH-USD; passed as the URL path segment.

usage.callShape: GET https://agents.x402stock.xyz/api/v1/crypto/{PAIR}/prev-close — PAIR is a BASE-QUOTE path segment (e.g. BTC-USD, ETH-USD), no query params, no request body. x402 USDC on Base (eip155:8453), fixed $0.01 per call.
usage.outputShape: JSON object: ticker (e.g. 'X:BTCUSD'), data (the previous UTC-day daily bar: {open, high, low, close, volume, vwap, trade_count, timestamp} — data itself may be null when no bar exists), source ('x402stock'), as_of (ISO-8601 timestamp), and an optional feedback object ({endpoint:'/api/v1/feedback', method:'POST', free:true, note}).
quirks: The pair is a URL path segment as BASE-QUOTE (e.g. BTC-USD), not a query param or body. Substitute the desired pair.
GET request, no request body; no query params.

Returns the previous UTC calendar day's full daily OHLCV candle (00:00-24:00 UTC), not a live/session price — crypto trades 24/7 so there is no true session close. For a specific historical date use /api/v1/crypto/{pair}/open-close?date=YYYY-MM-DD; for intraday/multi-bar history use /api/v1/crypto/{pair}/aggregates; for Hyperliquid on-chain spot use /api/v1/spot.
data is nullable (anyOf object|null) and vwap/trade_count/timestamp are individually nullable — handle a missing candle gracefully.

payTo (0x682bc13594b51a16cdbdf2ab9d7437bbd86e120c) plus the extra.zeroclick agentPaymentId/zcRequestId are minted per-request by the x402stock payment gateway (5-minute expiry) — always re-quote from a live 402 at call time rather than trusting a stored payTo.

The live 402 also advertised an alternate MPP/Tempo payment rail (www-authenticate method 'tempo', protocols.mpp) alongside x402; only the x402 USDC-on-Base accept was used and is recorded here — MPP/Tempo is a different protocol and out of scope for this registry.
Served via the agents.x402stock.xyz agent-facing payment gateway (same x402stock brand/provider as the bare x402stock.xyz entries); the provider's docs instruct agents to call through this host.
usage.guide: Get yesterday's full daily OHLCV candle for a crypto spot pair in one call. GET https://agents.x402stock.xyz/api/v1/crypto/{PAIR}/prev-close with the pair as a BASE-QUOTE path segment (e.g. BTC-USD, ETH-USD) — no query params, no request body. Pay the fixed $0.01 x402 USDC quote on Base (no API key, no sign-in) and read the JSON inline (synchronous, no polling). Response: `data` is the previous UTC-day candle with `open`/`high`/`low`/`close`/`volume`/`vwap`/`trade_count` and a `timestamp` (UTC day-end); `ticker` echoes the resolved symbol (e.g. 'X:BTCUSD'), `source` is 'x402stock', and `as_of` is the data timestamp. Verified 2026-08-07: paid $0.01 for BTC-USD and got open 64603.02 / high 65021 / low 64087.41 / close 64259.2 / volume 7367.465 / vwap 64532.5409 / trade_count 510509 for the 2026-08-06 UTC bar. `data` can be null if no bar exists for the pair.

name: x402stock Perps Candles

billing.description: amount is the price and is charged in full when you pay, and is not returned if delivery fails: this rail settles once and cannot give change. (Exact entries appear only on fixed-price requests - ceiling-priced requests are offered the reserve-and-pay-actual entry instead.)

usage.callShape: GET https://agents.x402stock.xyz/api/v1/perps/candles/:coin — substitute :coin with a Hyperliquid perp symbol (e.g. BTC, ETH). Optional query params: interval (enum 1m,3m,5m,15m,30m,1h,2h,4h,8h,12h,1d,3d,1w,1M; default 1h), lookback (integer 1–5000 candles, default 200), or an explicit start/end epoch-ms range. No request body. x402 USDC on Base (eip155:8453), fixed $0.02 per call (not dynamic).
usage.outputShape: JSON object: source ('x402stock'), as_of (ISO-8601 timestamp), venue ('hyperliquid'), coin (echoes input), interval (echoes requested, e.g. '1h'), count (number of candles), candles[] — each { start (ISO-8601), end (ISO-8601), open, high, low, close, volume, trades } (oldest-first). name: Arkham Unenriched Transfers
description: Query Arkham's raw (unenriched) cross-chain ERC-20/SPL token-transfer feed with rich filters — by base entity/address, from/to, counterparties, chains, tokens, USD/token-amount ranges, time window, flow direction, sequence range, sort, and pagination — returning transfer rows with from/to addresses, token metadata, unit value, and historical USD.

inputSchema.description: All fields optional. limit drives the price ($0.20 per row). String/number/boolean/array accepted for each filter (the schema allows anyOf) but comma-separated strings are the documented usage.

limit.description: Maximum number of results (transfer rows) to return. Default 20, max 1650. Each row costs $0.20 — pass the smallest useful limit.

offset.description: Pagination offset. Default 0. offset + limit must not exceed 10000.

base.description: Filter from or to any of a comma-separated list of entities or addresses. Prefix a value with '!' to exclude it.

from.description: Filter from any of a comma-separated list of addresses, entities, or deposit services. Prefix with '!' to exclude.

to.description: Filter to any of a comma-separated list of addresses, entities, or deposit services. Prefix with '!' to exclude.

counterparties.description: List of addresses/entities to treat strictly as counterparties (only base <-> counterparty transfers).

chains.description: Chains to filter by, as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'ethereum,bsc'). Omitted = all chains.

tokens.description: Filter involving any of a comma-separated list of token addresses or token IDs.

usdGte.description: Filter above a minimum historical USD value.

usdLte.description: Filter below a maximum historical USD value.

valueGte.description: Filter above a minimum token amount (quantity of tokens, not USD).

valueLte.description: Filter below a maximum token amount (quantity of tokens, not USD).

timeGte.description: Filter after a specific time (RFC3339, YYYY-MM-DD, or Unix timestamp).

timeLte.description: Filter before a specific time (RFC3339, YYYY-MM-DD, or Unix timestamp).

seqGte.description: Return transfers at or after this chain sequence. Requires seqLte.

seqLte.description: Return transfers at or before this chain sequence. Requires seqGte; range may span at most 10,000,000 sequences.

sortDir.description: Direction for sorting results. Default: desc.

sortKey.description: Field to sort by. Default: time. Custom sort keys require authentication; anonymous requests are always sorted by time.

includeCursors.description: Include per-chain as-of cursors in the response. Default: false.

usage.callShape: POST https://api.arkm.com/x402/transfers/unenriched with a JSON body of optional filters; pass limit (default 20, max 1650) to bound results — each row costs $0.20 USDC. Pays via x402 on Base (eip155:8453) or Solana. Synchronous JSON result returned inline in the 200.
usage.outputShape: {count:<int>, transfers:[{id, transactionHash, fromAddress:{address,chain}, fromIsContract, toAddress:{address,chain}, toIsContract, tokenAddress, tokenName, tokenSymbol, tokenDecimals, tokenId, unitValue, historicalUSD, type, chain, blockNumber, blockHash, blockTimestamp, seq}]}. Live verified: {"limit":1} -> HTTP 200, count=10000, transfers[0] = a Base VVV (Venice Token) transfer {unitValue:0.000311588636385929, historicalUSD:0.00358, blockNumber:49676979, seq:1449368893}. count is the total match count for the filter, not the number of rows returned.
quirks: PRICED PER ROW: $0.20 x limit. Empty/default body = limit 20 = $4.00; ALWAYS pass the smallest useful limit. limit=1 = $0.20; verified live.
'Unenriched' = raw transfer rows (from/to addresses, token metadata, unit value, historical USD) WITHOUT the entity/label enrichment of the sibling /x402/transfers ($0.40/row).
count in the response is the total number of matching transfers for the filter (capped example value 10000), NOT the number of rows returned — that is bounded by limit.
Custom sortKey requires authentication; anonymous (x402-only) requests are always sorted by time.
offset + limit must not exceed 10000; seqGte/seqLte must be supplied together and span at most 10,000,000 sequences.
All body filters accept string/number/boolean/array (schema anyOf), but comma-separated strings are the documented form (e.g. chains:'ethereum,bsc').
usage.guide: Query Arkham's raw cross-chain token-transfer feed. POST https://api.arkm.com/x402/transfers/unenriched with a JSON body of optional filters. PRICING IS PER ROW: $0.20 x limit (default 20 -> $4; max 1650) — always pass the smallest useful limit (e.g. {"limit":1} = $0.20). No API key; pays USDC via x402 on Base or Solana. Common filters: base/from/to (comma-separated addresses or entities, '!'-prefix to exclude), counterparties, chains ('ethereum,bsc'), tokens (addresses or token IDs), flow ('in'|'out'|'self'|'all'), usdGte/usdLte (historical USD), valueGte/valueLte (token quantity), timeGte/timeLte/timeLast, seqGte+seqLte, sortDir/sortKey (custom sort needs auth), offset, includeCursors. Returns synchronously {count, transfers:[{id, transactionHash, fromAddress, toAddress, tokenAddress/Name/Symbol/Decimals/Id, unitValue, historicalUSD, chain, blockNumber, blockTimestamp, seq}]}. Use for raw onchain transfer/txn monitoring; for label/entity-enriched rows use the sibling /x402/transfers. Example: {"limit":1} returned a Base VVV transfer with unitValue ~0.00031 and historicalUSD ~0.0036.

usage.guide: Perpetual-futures trading leaderboard ranking trader wallets by total PnL (USD), ROI, and account value over a date range, with Nansen entity/whale labels. POST JSON. Output: data[] {trader_address, trader_address_label, total_pnl, roi, account_value}; pagination {page, per_page, is_last_page}

name: Nansen Perp Screener

backends.inputSchema: POST JSON body. Required: 'date' object {from, to} (ISO-8601 UTC). Optional: 'filters' {token_symbol, volume:{min}}, 'order_by' [{direction:DESC|ASC, field}], 'pagination'.
backends.outputSchema: {data: [{volume, buy_volume, sell_volume, buy_sell_pressure, trader_count, token_symbol, mark_price, funding, open_interest, previous_price_usd}], pagination:{page, per_page, is_last_page}}

usage.callShape: POST JSON. Required top-level 'date' object {from, to} (ISO-8601 UTC). Optional: 'filters' (e.g. {token_symbol, volume:{min}}), 'order_by' [{direction, field}], 'pagination'.
usage.outputShape: data[] {volume, buy_volume, sell_volume, buy_sell_pressure, trader_count, token_symbol, mark_price, funding (hourly funding rate), open_interest, previous_price_usd}; pagination {page, per_page, is_last_page}. usage.guide: Screen/rank perpetual-futures contracts. POST JSON to https://api.nansen.ai/api/v1/perp-screener with a required top-level 'date' object {from,to} (ISO-8601 UTC range), plus optional 'filters' (e.g. {token_symbol:'BTC', volume:{min:10000}}), 'order_by' [{direction:'DESC', field:'buy_sell_pressure'}], and 'pagination'. Pays $0.01 USDC via x402 (Base USDC eip155:8453 default; also X Layer/eip155:196 USD₮0, several BSC/eip155:56 stables, and Solana USDC). Synchronous — result inline in the 200 body. Read rows from data[]: each has volume, buy_volume, sell_volume, buy_sell_pressure, trader_count, token_symbol, mark_price, funding (hourly funding rate), open_interest, previous_price_usd; pagination carries {page, per_page, is_last_page}. Use it to rank perps by flow pressure, funding, and open interest over a window.

usage.outputShape: pagination {page, per_page, is_last_page}; data[] {event_id, event_title, tags[], neg_risk, market_count, total_volume, total_volume_24hr, total_volume_1wk, total_volume_1mo, total_liquidity, total_open_interest, total_volume_change_pct, total_traders_24h, max_age_hours, top_market_id, top_market_question, top_market_volume_24hr, markets[] {market_id, question, volume_24hr, open_interest, best_bid, best_ask, last_trade_price, one_day_price_change, volume_change_pct, unique_traders_24h, end_date}}

name: Nansen Prediction Market OHLCV
description: OHLCV price candles (open/high/low/close, USD volume, trade count, unique traders) per outcome token for a Polymarket prediction market, over an optional date range.

usage.callShape: POST JSON. Required: 'market_id' (STRING, Polymarket market ID). Optional: 'date' {from,to} ISO-8601, 'order_by' [{direction:'ASC'|'DESC', field:'period_start'}], 'pagination' {page,per_page}. ('sort' is deprecated — use 'order_by'.)
usage.outputShape: pagination {page, per_page, is_last_page}; data[] {market_id, token_id, side ('Yes'/'No'), outcome_index, period_start (ISO datetime), open, high, low, close, volume_usd, trade_count, unique_traders}

usage.guide: OHLCV price candles for a Polymarket prediction market. POST JSON to https://api.nansen.ai/api/v1/prediction-market/ohlcv with a required 'market_id' (Polymarket market ID string, e.g. '654412'); optionally add 'date' {from,to} ISO-8601, 'order_by' [{direction:'DESC',field:'period_start'}] and 'pagination' {page,per_page}. Pay $0.01 USDC via x402 (Base and others; no API key). Read candles from data[]: each row is one outcome token (token_id + side 'Yes'/'No' + outcome_index) with open/high/low/close (0-1 implied-probability), volume_usd, trade_count and unique_traders for the period_start bucket. Page with pagination until is_last_page is true.

name: CoinStats Fear & Greed Chart
description: CoinStats Crypto Fear & Greed Index historical chart: a daily time series of the composite market-sentiment index (0-100 value plus classification) going back ~1 year. First-party CoinStats x402 endpoint (x402.coinstats.app); no API key, no input required.

usage.callShape: GET https://x402.coinstats.app/insights/fear-and-greed/chart. No request body, no query params, no path params. The endpoint returns HTTP 402 with x402 payment requirements on the first call, then HTTP 200 with the data once an EIP-3009 USDC authorization is signed. Pays $0.001 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453).
usage.outputShape: Flat JSON object: name (string, 'Fear and Greed Index') and data (array, most-recent-first). Each data[] item = {timestamp (string, Unix seconds), value (integer 0-100), value_classification (string, one of 'Extreme fear'|'Fear'|'Neutral'|'Greed'|'Extreme greed')}. Verified live: ~365 daily points, e.g. {"name":"Fear and Greed Index","data":[{"timestamp":"1785974400","value":38,"value_classification":"Fear"}, ...]}.
quirks: No input of any kind - a bare GET returns the full historical series; the OpenAPI/bazaar schema only requires the HTTP method 'GET'.
data[] is ordered most-recent-first and is roughly one point per day covering ~1 year (~365 entries).
timestamp is a STRING of Unix seconds (not a number); value is a JSON integer 0-100; value_classification uses lowercase 'fear' spelling ('Extreme fear', 'Fear', 'Neutral', 'Greed', 'Extreme greed').
Distinct from the sibling /insights/fear-and-greed which returns the current single index value; use this /chart route for the historical time series.
Synchronous: the full series is in the 200 body inline; no polling.
usage.guide: CoinStats Crypto Fear & Greed Index historical chart - a daily time series of the composite market-sentiment index. First-party CoinStats x402 endpoint; no API key, no input required. GET https://x402.coinstats.app/wallet/blockchains with no body/query/path params. Pays $0.001 USDC via x402 on Base (eip155:8453). Output is a JSON array (verified: 152 chains); each element has connectionId (the identifier used to connect/select a wallet chain in other CoinStats wallet calls), name (display name), chain (canonical chain slug), and icon (PNG URL). Use it as the source-of-truth enumeration of valid connectionId/chain values before calling other CoinStats wallet endpoints, or to render a chain picker.
